* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.

**Education**:

Position Overview:


The Ops Staff is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.

Shipment Processing \& Operations

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.

* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.

Data Entry \& Operational Documentation

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.

* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.

Education:

* Minimum 10th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:

* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


Skills \& Capabilities:


Technical Skills:

* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding


Key Competencies:

* Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance

KRAs KPIs


Operational Productivity Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence


Quality \& Accuracy Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.

**Job Summary**

They are master troubleshooters and follow consistent, logical steps to identify/replicate issues, isolate causes and report back to clients on resolution. They are responsible for providing high\-quality technical support for the Granicus software services we provide to the government and public. This person will also work on other programming and documentation projects as required. The Technical Support team partners with the Customer Support team in maintaining a “Customer Focused” environment, partnering with our stakeholders to achieve the highest customer lifetime value and satisfaction. This role requires the individual to be a US Citizen and CJIS certified (FBI Background check).
   

  

**What Your Impact Will Look Like**
* Field complex/escalated issues for high value or critical clients
* Work directly with clients to understand issues, document in a case, and work towards resolution.
* Uphold SLA’s regarding responsiveness on individual cases.
* Serve as an escalation point for Customer Support Representatives and be the resident product subject matter expert for a specific product suite/team.
* Taking ownership of technical issues and working with our Engineering and product groups to resolve more advanced issues when necessary.
* Validate and identify product bugs and be able to document the expected behaviors for resolution.
* Coordinate teams, set up client troubleshooting sessions, and provide written and verbal recaps.
* Resolving escalated customer complaints, especially when technical in nature, without the need for team lead or managerial intervention.
* On\-call support
* Help train more junior members/ customer support representatives on our software and processes
* Updating the ticket tracking system to provide an accurate, and current, status of support issues.
* Creating Knowledge Base articles to expand the knowledge for handling support issues.
* Ability to troubleshoot issues ranging from simple single failures to complex multi\-factored problems.

* Ambitious, self\-driven and an enthusiastic approach to problem\-solving.

* 1 year experience providing technical support for cloud\-based software or services.

* You’ve used ticketing systems such as Zendesk, JIRA, Salesforce or other.
* You have a technical degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience (2\+ yrs.).

* You have enterprise SaaS or web\-hosted software knowledge.
* You have experience with streaming/video playback
* You have experience with Github, CI / CD, software deployment.

 Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

* Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
* Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.


**The Team**
* We are a remote\-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.


**The Culture**
* At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to be a part of our journey.
* A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices
* Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important and sometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work\-life balance and current affairs.
* Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
* We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employee population


**The Impact**
* We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here .


**The Benefits**
 At Granicus, we offer a
 **comprehensive and flexible benefits package** 
 designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.
   

  

 Here’s what you can expect as a Puerto Rico\-based team member:

* Online Learning Platforms – Fuel your professional development.

All qualified applicants and employees will be considered for employment and advancement without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, age, genetic information, sexual or affectional orientation, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, familial status, military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Engineering based in India.**
 This is a pivotal technical leadership opportunity within an early\-stage wearable sensing and robotics environment. The role owns end\-to\-end engineering execution for a body\-worn sensing platform, from system architecture through production. You will lead a distributed team of hardware specialists across India and the US while remaining deeply hands\-on with critical technical challenges. The position spans power systems, sensor synchronization, firmware, embedded Linux, mechanical engineering, and system integration. Your decisions will directly influence product reliability, wearability, performance, and the capabilities of the underlying technology. This is an on\-site role in India with regular travel to San Francisco, approximately one week per month.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Own end\-to\-end technical execution of a body\-worn sensing platform, from architecture and prototyping through production and shipping.
* Lead and coordinate a distributed engineering team across India and the US, maintaining technical quality and effective collaboration across time zones.
* Define and maintain the overall hardware system architecture, ensuring mechanical, electrical, power, sensor, and firmware subsystems integrate into a cohesive wearable product.
* Make critical design and integration decisions involving power systems, sensor synchronization, firmware, embedded Linux, and mechanical structures.
* Translate product requirements into clear, actionable engineering briefs that enable distributed teams to execute effectively.
* Apply first\-principles engineering to power architecture, including multi\-rail battery systems, protection circuits, regulator selection, inrush behavior, brownouts, and schematic analysis.
* Solve complex sensor synchronization challenges involving mismatched sample rates, variable bus latency, firmware timestamping, and real\-world dataset alignment.
* Debug firmware and system\-level issues using schematics, logic analyzers, serial logs, and other diagnostic tools.
* Review and challenge mechanical designs with a focus on engineering integrity, wearability, durability, load paths, tolerance stack\-ups, and strain relief.
* Take hands\-on ownership of critical technical systems and evaluate their impact on product performance and underlying model capabilities.
* Shape hiring criteria, interview processes, and team development practices as the engineering organization grows.
* Support supply chain, vendor management, manufacturing handoff, regulatory compliance, and production scale\-up where required.


**Requirements**
* 6–10\+ years of hardware engineering experience developing wearable devices, robotics, motion\-capture systems, or field\-deployed hardware.
* Proven experience taking at least one hardware product through the complete development lifecycle, from initial prototype to deployment with real end users.
* US citizenship or a valid US visa is required; visa sponsorship is not available.
* Willingness to be based on\-site in India and travel to San Francisco approximately one week per month.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise in battery\-powered and multi\-rail power systems, including protection circuits, regulator topologies, inrush current, brownout analysis, and schematic review.
* Strong experience with sensor synchronization across different sample rates and variable bus latencies, including firmware\-level timestamping and diagnosis of real\-world data misalignment.
* Practical firmware and embedded Linux expertise, including bringing up SoM/SBC platforms and debugging timing, interrupts, buffers, and related system issues.
* Strong mechanical engineering judgment, including understanding of load paths, tolerance stack\-ups, strain relief, durability, and wearable ergonomics.
* Previous experience operating as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Founding Engineer, or in a similarly senior technical capacity, rather than solely as an engineering manager.
* Demonstrated ability to lead distributed technical teams and maintain engineering standards without relying on daily in\-person oversight.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to translate product requirements into precise engineering specifications and execution briefs.
* Experience with hardware supply chains and vendor management is an advantage.
* Familiarity with UL/IEC regulatory requirements for wearable devices is a plus.
* Experience with manufacturing handoff and hardware production scale\-up is desirable.


**Benefits**
* Salary: $140,000–$210,000 USD annually.
* Significant technical ownership at a critical stage of growth within the wearable sensing and robotics space.
* Opportunity to shape the engineering architecture, technical standards, and culture of a growing organization.
* Hands\-on involvement across hardware, firmware, mechanical engineering, sensing, and system integration.
* Opportunity to lead and develop a distributed engineering team across India and the United States.
* On\-site work in India with regular travel to San Francisco, approximately one week per month.
* Opportunity to directly influence product quality, reliability, and the capabilities of the underlying technology.

title: Script Writer + Manager
description:
Fable Labs is looking for a **Script Writer / Creative Writer** who can turn products, consumer problems and random observations into video ideas people actually want to watch.

We create **UGC ads, short\-form video ads, creator\-led content and performance marketing creatives** for D2C and consumer brands.

We're not looking for someone who only knows how to write grammatically correct sentences.

We're looking for someone who can think:

**Hook → Problem → Story → Product → Proof → Payoff**

If you regularly save interesting ads, analyse why certain Reels work, write funny observations in your Notes app, or instinctively think *“this could be a great ad”* when something happens around you, this role might be for you.

What You'll Be Writing

You will work on:

* UGC Ad Scripts
* Instagram \& Facebook Ad Scripts
* Short\-Form Video Scripts
* Performance Marketing Ads
* Creator\-Led Advertisements
* Product Demonstration Scripts
* Testimonials
* Problem\-Solution Ads
* Skits
* Conversational Ads
* Vox Pop Concepts
* Hooks \& Opening Lines
* Multiple Hook Variations
* D2C Product Ads
* Social Media Content
* Creative Concepts \& Campaign Ideas

What You'll Do

As a Script Writer at Fable Labs, you'll:

* Write engaging short\-form video scripts for brands
* Research products, competitors and target customers before writing
* Develop strong hooks that can capture attention within the first few seconds
* Turn product features into interesting consumer stories
* Write natural dialogue that doesn't sound like traditional advertising
* Create UGC\-style scripts that actors and creators can deliver naturally
* Generate multiple creative angles for the same product
* Write multiple hook variations for creative testing
* Develop skits, scenarios, visual gags and storytelling concepts
* Study winning advertisements and understand why they work
* Use customer reviews, comments and pain points while developing scripts
* Work with videographers, editors, actors and the creative team
* Modify scripts based on client and creative feedback
* Think about how every line will actually be shot instead of writing scripts that only look good on paper

Skills We're Looking For

You should have a good understanding of:

* Script Writing
* Creative Writing
* Copywriting
* Storytelling
* Social Media Content
* Short\-Form Video
* Advertising
* Instagram Reels
* Consumer Psychology
* Hooks \& Attention
* Research
* D2C / E\-commerce Brands

You should be comfortable writing in **English and conversational Hinglish** when required.

Perfect grammar alone isn't enough.

We care more about whether you can understand **people, humour, problems, products and attention.**

Who Should Apply?

You could be:

* A Script Writer
* Creative Copywriter
* Content Writer
* Social Media Writer
* Advertising Copywriter
* Creative Strategist
* Content Creator
* Screenwriter interested in advertising
* Marketing student with strong writing ability
* Fresher with an excellent writing portfolio

**Freshers are welcome to apply if they can demonstrate strong creative thinking.**

Your degree matters much less to us than your ability to come up with ideas.

What We're NOT Looking For

This probably isn't the right role if your writing is primarily:

* SEO blogs
* Generic ChatGPT\-generated articles
* Corporate website copy
* Long\-form informational content
* Rewritten versions of competitor ads

This role is heavily focused on **ideas, scripts, hooks and advertising concepts.**

We want writers who can take something as simple as underwear, skincare, perfume, a gadget or a household product and find an unexpectedly interesting way to sell it.

A Typical Creative Challenge Might Look Like:

**Product:** Men's underwear

Instead of simply writing:

“Made with comfortable and breathable fabric.”

We'd want you thinking:

**What's the awkward situation where this feature suddenly matters?**

Can it become a date story?

An office situation?

A gym moment?

A conversation between two friends?

A ridiculous visual demonstration?

A confession?

A comparison?

A skit?

That's the kind of thinking this role requires.

About Fable Labs

Fable Labs is a creative advertising agency working with D2C and consumer brands.

We treat creative work like a laboratory.

We experiment with:

**Hooks. Scripts. Actors. Formats. Visual demonstrations. Stories. Editing styles.**

Then we learn what works and use those learnings to make the next creative stronger.

You'll get to write across different products, categories and advertising formats rather than producing the same kind of content every day.

Why Join Fable Labs?

You'll get hands\-on exposure to:

* D2C Advertising
* UGC Ads
* Performance Marketing Creatives
* Creative Strategy
* Consumer Research
* Video Production
* Actors \& Creators
* Script Testing
* Hook Testing
* Advertising Psychology
* Real Brand Campaigns

More importantly, you'll actually get to **see your scripts become videos.**

You'll be able to watch an idea go from:

**Random thought → Script → Shoot → Edit → Live Ad**

And then learn from how that creative performs.

Job Details

**Position:** Script Writer – Social Media \& Video Ads

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Location:** Thane / Mumbai

**Work Mode:** On\-site

Application Requirement

Please share any relevant writing samples, scripts, advertisements, social media content or portfolio while applying.

If you don't have professional experience yet, you may also share **3–5 original sample ad concepts or scripts** that demonstrate how you think.

We care less about how many years you've been writing and more about whether reading your idea makes us think:

**“We should shoot this.”**

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About The Role**
 We’re building a travel platform spanning
 **Flights, Hotels, and Experiences** 
 for one of the largest telecom operators in Europe. The product brings together multiple travel partners and integrates deeply with the telecom’s loyalty ecosystem to create a seamless booking experience for millions of users.
   

  

 We’re looking for an
 **Associate Product Manager / Product Manager** 
 who is excited by the challenge of building products from the ground up. You’ll work across the entire product lifecycle—from identifying customer problems and defining solutions to launching features, measuring their impact, and continuously improving the experience.
   

  

 This role doesn’t end at launch. Once the product is live, you will work closely with users, analyze data, identify opportunities, and drive product\-led growth initiatives that improve conversion, engagement, retention, and customer satisfaction. You’ll play a key role in shaping the product into one that customers love and one that delivers meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

 If you’re someone who enjoys solving customer problems, making data\-driven decisions, and taking ownership from idea to impact, you’ll thrive in this role.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Help build and scale the Flights, Hotels, and Experiences product from the ground up.
* Own product initiatives from discovery and problem definition through launch and post\-launch optimization.
* Work closely with engineering, design, business, and external partners to deliver high\-quality product experiences.
* Translate customer problems and business opportunities into clear product requirements and PRDs.
* Define priorities, manage execution, and ensure timely delivery of product initiatives.
* Analyze user behavior, funnel metrics, customer feedback, and business performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Design, prioritize, and execute product\-led growth initiatives to improve acquisition, conversion, engagement, repeat usage, and retention.
* Run experiments, measure outcomes, and iterate rapidly based on customer insights and data.
* Coordinate with integration partners to ensure reliable and scalable customer experiences.
* Continuously refine the product based on user feedback, analytics, and evolving business needs.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 2 to 4 years of product management experience building consumer or marketplace products.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data to drive product decisions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to simplify complex problems into intuitive customer experiences.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with ambiguity.
* Curiosity to understand customers, technology, and business—not just feature requirements.


 Above all, we’re looking for someone with a strong sense of ownership. Someone who treats the product as their own, takes initiative without waiting to be asked, and is driven to create meaningful customer and business impact. We value people who are naturally curious, proactive, and passionate about building great products \- people who don’t stop once a feature is launched but continuously look for ways to make the product better.
   

  

**We’d Love to See**
**Role**
 While not a requirement, we’d especially love to hear from candidates who have demonstrated a strong builder mindset outside their day\-to\-day role. This could include:
   

  

* Founding or being an early member of a startup.
* Building a meaningful side project, product, business, or venture from scratch.
* Pursuing entrepreneurial experiences that required taking ownership, navigating ambiguity, and learning by doing.
* Choosing an unconventional career path to build something of your own before or alongside a corporate role.


 These experiences aren’t mandatory, but they often reflect the qualities we value most \- ownership, resourcefulness, resilience, and a bias toward action. If you have built something you are proud of, we would love to hear about it.

**About Roofglow Solar**

Roofglow Solar Private Limited is a solar EPC company based in Chennai, delivering end\-to\-end residential and commercial rooftop solar solutions — from site assessment and system design to installation, documentation, and subsidy support — across Chennai, Kanchipuram, Thiruvallur, and Chengalpattu districts of Tamil Nadu.

**Working at Roofglow**

We're a small, fast\-moving team where everyone wears multiple hats and has direct access to the founder. We value performance and attitude over hierarchy — no egos, a collaborative environment, and real ownership from day one.

**A Note on Incentives**

The incentive amount for this role is paid once the originating project reaches successful installation and commissioning — not at the point of lead conversion, appointment booking, or contract signing alone.

**Content \& Digital Marketing Executive**

**Department:** Marketing \& Growth

**Employment Type:** Full\-time, 6\-day work week

**Location:** Chennai (covering Chennai, Kanchipuram, Thiruvallur \& Chengalpattu)

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a creative, growth\-focused Content \& Digital Marketing Executive to build Roofglow's local brand presence and directly drive qualified leads. Beyond content, you own our entire digital presence and every channel that generates leads — and you're expected to personally convert a share of the enquiries your own content brings in, not just hand them off.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Content Creation \& Video Editing***

* Shoot, edit, and publish short\-form video reels, customer testimonials, and installation showcases across Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and LinkedIn.
* Ensure every piece meets a consistent quality bar — clean colour correction, clear audio, and tight pacing — and is delivered on time.
* Visit installation sites, coordinating with the Installation \& Execution Supervisor, to capture footage.

***Lead Generation \& Campaign Management***

* Set up and optimize localized Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google ad campaigns to generate warm solar leads.
* Own Roofglow's full digital presence and every channel that generates leads — website, social, and listings.
* Own Roofglow's SEO end to end — on\-page optimization, local search/Google Business Profile, and keyword strategy — so the website and PM Surya Ghar listing rank well for local searches.
* Keep an eye on what fellow solar brands in the area are doing and adapt content/campaigns accordingly.

***Digital Sales \& Enablement***

* Handle initial social media/WhatsApp DM conversations, engage prospective buyers directly, and convert straightforward enquiries yourself where possible; hand off more complex leads into the Telecaller/Solar Consultant pipeline.
* Coordinate daily with the Inside Sales Executive so leads generated by content are followed up promptly.

***BTL \& Local Activations***

* Plan and coordinate localized awareness drives, canopy setups, pamphlets, handbills, and customer events across the coverage area.
* Build and maintain a small network of local vendors (printers, event/canopy suppliers) to support promotional activities.

title: Junior Developer / Software Engineering Intern
description:
WANT TO KICK START YOUR IT CAREER? Then you are at right place,

I’m looking for a junior developer or intern who can take responsibility for day\-to\-day development and maintenance of our web and mobile products.

This is not a role where you will only be assigned small, isolated tasks. I’m looking for someone who can gradually take ownership of features and projects, understand how the product works end\-to\-end, test their own work properly, troubleshoot issues, and work closely with senior developers.

The ideal person should be curious, responsible, comfortable learning new technologies, and willing to take ownership rather than waiting for instructions for every small task.

Technical Exposure

Depending on the project, you may work with:

\* React

\* TypeScript

\* Expo

\* React Native

\* Android

\* Java

\* Kotlin

\* XML

\* Jetpack Compose

\* REST APIs and backend integrations

\* Git/GitHub

\* Debugging, logging, and troubleshooting

\* Testing across web and mobile

\* Other relevant technologies as required by the projects

You do not need to be an expert in all of these technologies. Strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly are more important.

Responsibilities

\* Maintain and improve existing websites and applications.

\* Develop new features for web and mobile applications.

\* Work closely with senior developers on ongoing projects.

\* Understand existing codebases and make changes without breaking existing functionality.

\* Test features end\-to\-end before considering them complete.

\* Debug issues across frontend, mobile, API, and integration layers.

\* Investigate problems independently before escalating them.

\* Fix bugs and handle small\-to\-medium development tasks independently.

\* Work with Git and follow proper development practices.

\* Help monitor and maintain existing products.

\* Take responsibility for assigned features and make sure they are properly implemented, tested, and delivered.

\* Communicate clearly when something is blocked, unclear, or needs senior\-level input.

What Matters Most

I care more about your approach to development than knowing every technology listed above.

You should:

\* Take ownership of your work.

\* Be comfortable asking questions when necessary.

\* Be willing to investigate problems independently.

\* Understand that development includes testing and debugging, not just writing code.

\* Be comfortable working on an existing codebase.

\* Pay attention to details.

\* Be willing to work across different technologies when a project requires it.

\* Be comfortable working closely with senior developers.

\* Be willing to learn and improve continuously.

\* Take responsibility for the outcome of your work.

Ideal Candidate

This role would be a good fit for someone who may not have extensive professional experience yet but has strong fundamentals, personal projects, internship experience, or a genuine interest in software development.

I would rather work with someone who knows less but takes ownership, learns quickly, and thinks through problems than someone who knows a particular framework but needs to be guided through every task.

Experience

\* Internship / 0–2 years of professional development experience.

\* Freshers with strong projects and fundamentals are welcome.

\* Experience with React, React Native, Android, or similar technologies is a plus.

\* Personal projects, GitHub projects, or previous internships can be considered as relevant experience.

Working Style

You will work closely with senior developers and should be comfortable receiving feedback, discussing implementation decisions, and improving your approach.

The expectation is that as you gain familiarity with the products and codebase, you should be able to take increasing ownership of features and projects.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
Sprinto is an **Autonomous Trust Platform** that centralizes trust requirements across **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**



Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.



Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve **raised** **$31\.8M** in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over **4,000 organizations across 75 countries**, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With **300\+ native integrations** and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports **200\+ global security standards natively**, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.


**Founded in 2020** by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.


### **Life as a Sprinter \-**



Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.



We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.



Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.



We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.



And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.


### **The mission \-**



Help us build a thoughtful, high\-velocity talent acquisition engine, one that makes it easier for great people to discover us, have an exceptional candidate experience, and ultimately become part of the team.



As a Talent Acquisition Intern, you’ll work closely with the recruiting team across the full hiring process. You’ll get hands\-on exposure to managing candidate pipelines, interview coordination, recruiting operations, and the systems and processes that enable a growing team to hire well.



You’ll have the opportunity to understand how a recruiting function works end\-to\-end, identify what can be better, and help build the systems and workflows that make hiring more effective.



### **Where you'll leave your mark?**


* **Build and manage candidate pipelines:** Keep candidate pipelines organized, up to date, and moving across our ATS system.
* **Create a great candidate experience:** Coordinate interviews, manage scheduling, and ensure candidates receive timely, thoughtful, and clear communication throughout the process.
* **Keep the hiring engine moving:** Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to track candidates, follow up on next steps, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
* **Make recruiting workflows better:** Identify bottlenecks and repetitive processes, and help improve recruitment workflows, systems, and operating rhythms.
* **Bring structure to the process:** Maintain accurate candidate data, recruiting documentation, and reporting so the team has visibility into the hiring funnel.
### **The kind of builder we're looking for \-**


* You **communicate clearly**, thoughtfully, and with empathy — especially when interacting with candidates.
* You **take ownership**: if you see something that needs to get done, you don’t wait for someone else to notice it.
* You’re **detail\-oriented** and understand that small things can have a big impact on the candidate experience.
* You’re curious about how systems work and enjoy learning new tools and processes.
* You have a **bias toward action** and are comfortable figuring things out as you go.
* You naturally spot things that are broken, inefficient, or unnecessarily manual — and want to fix them.
* You are available to **join us immediately**.
* Prior experience in recruiting, HR, operations, or an ATS is a plus — but **curiosity, ownership, and learning velocity matter more.**
### **Inclusion \& Diversity \-**



At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.



We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: IT Support Specialist II
description:
* Bangalore, No. 6/12, Primrose Road, Gurappa Avenue, Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
* **Category:** IT
* **Type:** Full\-time
* **Min. Experience:** Some Experience
**About Betterworks**



Betterworks is HR software to align, develop, and activate your workforce for business growth. Organizations are able to replace outdated, ineffective, universally loathed annual review processes with powerful Continuous Performance Management programs that help managers be better at the conversations, coaching, and development necessary to inspire and motivate the entire workforce to achieve an organization's top priorities today and be ready for tomorrow's challenges.

  


**What You’ll Be Doing**



As the IT Support Specialist II for our internal IT team, you will work with IT leadership to execute a strategy that enables a simple and delightful IT experience for Betterworks employees. You will collaborate on and implement the technical roadmap for IT processes and services that help Betterworks be its most productive, with a focus on automation, simplification, and enablement. Your partnership with internal customers and vendors will be essential to re\-imagining the function of IT and unleashing new ways to work with a globally distributed workforce.


* Serve as the primary Tier 1 escalation point and first responder for IT functions via Slack, our ticketing system, and email — providing real\-time coverage during the UK/India/US East Coast overlap window
* Triage and resolve Tier 1 incidents using our incident management tooling, escalating appropriately when an issue requires deeper technical ownership
* Directly own IT support, MDM, and patch management for Betterworks employees, ensuring quality and timely resolution
* Fully own the end\-to\-end laptop lifecycle working directly alongside our vendor in India
* Maintain up\-to\-date hardware inventory
* Monitor and identify problem trends, propose proactive and well\-researched actions to prevent future occurrences
* Day\-to\-day administration of Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, and other corporate systems owned by IT
* Manage all aspects of the user account lifecycle, including procedures and administration related to onboarding, offboarding, and role changes, ensuring compliance requirements are met
* Participate in a continuous improvement culture; responsible for documentation, standardization, and improvement involving people, process, technology, and helpdesk support services. Regularly update IT knowledgebase, processes, and procedures as needed
* Participate in a customer service culture; responsible for building relationships with stakeholders and end users across all departments, seeking out feedback to ensure we're satisfying the needs of the organization
* Contribute to continuous improvement within IT using service management, metrics, self\-service, knowledge repositories, and other incident\-prevention approaches
* Work alongside IT leadership to implement system changes and execute projects, with occasional direct exposure to wider leadership on cross\-functional initiatives

  




**What’ll Help You Be Successful**


* You love helping people and are empathetic to customer needs
* You have the ability and desire to help others better utilize systems and software
* You have 4\+ years of relevant IT experience, including hands\-on experience managing both Mac and PC endpoints, utilizing MDM
* You have experience with Google Workspace and are familiar with common SaaS applications such as Okta, Zoom, Slack, and associated productivity tools
* You have exceptional communication, time management, and prioritization skills
* You're comfortable working a shifted schedule to provide real\-time overlap with UK, India, and US East Coast colleagues
* You have an experimental mindset that uses data and metrics to back up assumptions and support decision\-making
* You maintain a positive attitude and are a self\-starter who is excited about collaborating cross\-functionally.

  




**What We All Do**


* All employees share the responsibility of being aware of information security risks and adhering to information security policies and procedures.
* All employees are required to participate in information security awareness and training programs.
* All employees have a responsibility to handle data in accordance with data classification and handling guidelines. Employees should be aware of the sensitivity of the data they interact with and follow appropriate security measures.
* All employees have a responsibility of reporting information security incidents in accordance with information security policies and procedures.

  




**What Makes Betterworks Unique**



At Betterworks, we put our people first. To support this, we’ve built a culture and benefits program that prioritize both professional growth and personal well\-being:


* Leadership: Our CEO, Doug Dennerline is a mission\-driven leader with over 25 years of sales leadership experience, making a direct impact on the work people do every day.
* Funding: Backed by $129 million in Series B with top tier investors, including Kleiners Perkins, Emergence Capital, and 8VC.
* Board of Directors: Since the beginning of Betterworks, our board includes industry icons such as John Doerr (who introduced OKRs to Google), Bruce Felt (Founder of Renaissance Software and a trusted advisor to numerous private and public companies), Bing Gordon (Renowned Technology Venture Capitalist with experience on boards like Amazon, Duolingo and Zynga), Jason Green (Founder of Emergence Capital and Greenbridge Foundation) and Gaby Toledano (seasoned executive with nearly three decades of strategic HR and operations leadership at premier enterprise and consumer organizations).
* Perks: We provide company\-sponsored health, wellness, and personal accident insurance. Our remote\-first culture gives you the flexibility to work from anywhere in India, with opportunities to travel and connect as a team. To support your setup, we also offer a one\-time home office reimbursement and a monthly internet stipend to keep you seamlessly connected.
* Product: Recognized by Lighthouse Research \& Advisory and UNLEASH America, Betterworks was named a 2025 HR Tech Award winner for Best Comprehensive Talent Management Solution. We also received Newsweek’s AI Impact Award for Best Outcomes in HR, 2025\.
* Mission Driven: Our mission is to provide the expertise and technology companies need to inspire, develop, and activate their workforce to achieve today’s goals while preparing for tomorrow’s challenges.

  


Connect with us on LinkedIn  


*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse betterworks. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global betterworks Community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Senior Manager, Payroll – APAC
description:
We believe in a world where growth thrives across borders and cultures. Our mission is to guide companies on their journey by providing services and technology that enables global talent management and delivers a human experience.

  



As an Employer\-of\-Record (EOR) provider, we offer the HR and compliance infrastructure essential for companies to expand internationally. We take care of the complex, behind\-the\-scenes work, allowing companies to focus on the strategies that drive their success. We are For People, By People.

  



The future of work is borderless, and so are we. Our people are located around the globe — in the U.S., the UK, India, Colombia, China, and beyond. Diversity and belonging are not just values, they are who we are.

  



We are also committed to making a positive impact. Through our Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) impact initiative, we are addressing our environmental footprint and promoting social responsibility. Our impact program is central to our vision and culture, focusing on employee wellness, diversity, charitable work, and ethical corporate governance.

  



If you are interested in working in a people\-centric, global organization, apply below.

  



We are seeking an experienced and strategic **Senior Manager, Payroll for APAC,** to lead payroll operations across **APAC**. This role will oversee end\-to\-end payroll delivery, vendor performance, compliance, and process optimization to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely payroll execution across the region.



The successful candidate will combine deep **APAC** payroll expertise with strong operational leadership and continuous improvement capabilities. They will partner closely with Global Payroll leadership, Shared Services, HR, Finance, Legal, and external providers to drive operational excellence while supporting broader global payroll initiatives.



This role requires a hands\-on leader who can operate both strategically and tactically, influencing stakeholders at all levels while ensuring consistent, high\-quality payroll delivery across complex, multi\-country environments.



The Senior Manager is accountable for payroll service outcomes across **APAC**, including delivery quality, adherence to compliance, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation. The role owns regional payroll performance and is responsible for driving corrective actions when service outcomes do not meet defined standards.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Regional Payroll Leadership \& Execution**


* Lead end\-to\-end payroll operations across **APAC** countries, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant payroll processing.
* Own regional payroll delivery performance, including accountability for accuracy rates, timeliness, compliance adherence, and service quality outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with country\-specific employment laws, tax regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Manage Statutory submissions, including year\-end compliance outputs
* Act as the escalation point for complex payroll issues, audits, and compliance matters.
* Lead resolution of complex payroll and employee\-impacting issues, ensuring timely investigation, root cause identification, and sustainable corrective actions.
* Partner with customer\-facing teams to support payroll\-related client escalations and ensure professional, solution\-oriented engagement with customers when required.
* Provide training to Shared Services and other applicable teams to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Establish clear accountability across internal teams and vendors for payroll inputs, approvals, and delivery timelines.


Ensure payroll processes support a positive employee experience by minimizing payroll errors and resolving pay\-related inquiries impacting employees.


**Operational Excellence \& Process Improvement**


* Standardize payroll processes and controls across **APAC** markets to drive consistency and reduce risk.
* Identify opportunities for automation, simplification, and cost optimization.
* Implement and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) with the internal team and LPPs.
* Own performance against defined KPIs and SLAs, including development and execution of remediation plans when targets are not achieved.
* Drive improvement initiatives that create reliable, repeatable, and scalable payroll processes that will support expansion and growth opportunities across **APAC**.
* Utilize operational data, customer feedback, and issue trends to proactively identify systemic gaps and implement preventative solutions.

  


**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management**


* Manage relationships with **APAC** payroll vendors, ensuring strong service delivery, compliance, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Conduct regular vendor performance reviews and lead contract discussions where appropriate.
* Hold vendors accountable to contractual SLAs, service quality standards, and escalation response expectations.
* Partner with Shared Services, HR, Finance, Legal, and IT to ensure seamless payroll integration with upstream and downstream processes.
* Support broader global payroll initiatives, including system enhancements and vendor consolidation efforts.
* Collaborate with customer delivery and account management teams to ensure payroll services meet client expectations and contractual obligations.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**


* Ensure strong internal controls and audit readiness across all **APAC** payroll operations.
* Develop and maintain payroll governance frameworks, documentation, and reporting.
* Mitigate compliance risks through proactive monitoring and partnership with Legal and Compliance teams.
* Support internal and external audits as required.
* Own remediation planning and execution for audit findings, compliance gaps, or payroll delivery risks within defined timelines.
* Ensure clear documentation and traceability of payroll decisions, escalations, and resolutions impacting employees or customers.


**Qualifications \& Experience**


**Required**


* 10\-15 \+ years of progressive payroll leadership experience, with significant exposure to multi\-country **APAC** payroll.
* Strong knowledge of **APAC** payroll regulations, taxation, and employment legislation.
* Proven experience managing Local Payroll Providers (LPPs) across multiple countries.
* Demonstrated success in process improvement, standardization, and operational optimization.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior leadership.
* Experience leading teams in a complex, matrixed environment.
* Experience supporting payroll delivery in customer\-facing environments, including interaction with clients or internal customers regarding payroll outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience resolving complex payroll or employee pay issues requiring cross\-functional coordination and root cause analysis.


**Preferred**


* Experience in a multinational organization with regional or global payroll scope.
* Experience in payroll outsourcing and/or EOR.
* Exposure to payroll system implementations or integrations.
* Familiarity with Customer Support / Ticketing Systems such as Zendesk, HubSpot, Salesforce.
* Payroll certification (CPP, GPP, or equivalent).
* Experience supporting vendor consolidation and/or transformation initiatives.
* Experience operating within service delivery models with defined SLAs, customer performance metrics, or contractual service obligations.


**Key Competencies**


* Strategic thinker with strong operational execution capability
* Results\-driven, with a focus on accuracy and compliance
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Effective change leadership and stakeholder engagement
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Ability to navigate complexity across multiple **APAC** jurisdictions
* Customer\-oriented mindset with strong ownership of service outcomes and employee experience
* Ability to drive accountability across distributed teams and third\-party providers

  



This position description may not describe all duties, responsibilities, and skills associated with this position. It is intended to portray the major aspects of the job. Other duties or skills may be required.

  


**What We Offer**


* The opportunity to work with a purpose — simplifying global expansion across borders and cultures
* A diverse and inclusive environment
* Country\-specific benefits
* Flexible PTO
* Your birthday off and a day for you to volunteer and give back to the organization of your choice
* Generous Parental Leave Program
* Growth and development opportunities with access to a top learning content provider
* The opportunity to challenge yourself in a high\-performing organization and leave each day knowing you have made an impact.

5 years of experience in people management.

Great just isn't good enough for our People Operations team (known elsewhere as "Human Resources"). We bring the world's most innovative people to Google and provide the programs that help them thrive. Whether recruiting the next Googler, refining our core programs, developing talent, or simply looking for ways to inject some more fun into the lives of our Googlers, we bring a data\-driven approach that is reinventing the human resources field.

**Senior Payroll Analyst**

**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office****Senior Payroll Analyst, APAC**

**Department:** Global Payroll

**Position Summary**


We are seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented Senior Payroll Analyst to support the delivery of accurate and compliant payroll operations across the APAC region. This role is responsible for the end\-to\-end processing, validation, reconciliation, and governance of payrolls across multiple countries, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time while maintaining compliance with local statutory and company requirements.


The ideal candidate will have strong multi\-country payroll experience, exceptional analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with Human Resources, Finance, Tax, external payroll vendors, and employees across a diverse regional environment.


This role offers the opportunity to be a key contributor to a growing global payroll organization while supporting employees across the APAC region with accurate, compliant, and customer\-focused payroll services.

  

### **In this role you will...**


* Own end\-to\-end payroll processing for India and other APAC assigned countries, including payroll inputs, new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, commissions, allowances, deductions, and benefits. Support off\-cycle payrolls, supplemental payments, and payroll corrections as needed. Validation, payroll execution, statutory compliance, reconciliations, and vendor coordination.
* Serve as the payroll reviewer for assigned international payrolls (currently supporting up to eight countries), validating payroll outputs, legislative compliance, calculations, and adherence to company policies before payroll approval.
* Own the preparation, validation, approval coordination, and secure processing of payroll bank payment files across all supported countries, ensuring payment accuracy and compliance with internal financial controls.
* Review payroll variance reports, reconciliation reports, tax reports, and payroll outputs to proactively identify and resolve discrepancies before payroll sign\-off.
* Validate and ensure timely payment of statutory liabilities including PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, Income Tax, and other statutory obligations.
* Partner with payroll vendors, HR, Finance, HRIS, and business stakeholders to resolve complex payroll issues and improve service delivery.
* Act as the primary escalation point for payroll\-related queries, statutory matters, taxation, and payroll compliance.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve payroll SOPs, review checklists, process documentation, and governance controls to strengthen business continuity.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual payroll activities, improve operational controls, and drive process standardization across global payroll operations.
* Support internal and external payroll audits by ensuring complete documentation and compliance with audit requirements.
* Coach and cross\-train payroll team members, ensuring adequate backup coverage and reducing key\-person dependency.
* Perform additional responsibilities as required to support business objectives.

**Reporting \& Reconciliations**


Prepare and analyze payroll reports, reconciliations, and payroll\-related metrics.


Reconcile payroll registers, general ledger entries, tax filings, and benefit deductions.


Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies in a timely manner.


Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end payroll activities.


**Employee Support**


Respond to payroll inquiries from employees, managers, and HR partners.


Research and resolve complex payroll issues while providing excellent customer service.


Educate employees and stakeholders on payroll processes, policies, and compliance requirements.

  

### **You’ve got what it takes if you have…**


Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.


5\+ years of payroll experience, including multi\-country APAC payroll processing.


Strong understanding of payroll regulations, taxation, and statutory requirements across APAC countries.


Experience working with outsourced payroll providers.


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis.


Experience with global payroll systems such as **Activ8** or similar platforms.


Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and reconciliation skills.


Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.


Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict payroll deadlines.


**Preferred Qualifications**


Experience supporting payrolls in countries such as India, Australia, Finland, New Zealand, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, and Hong Kong.


Experience in a multinational organization with global payroll operations.


Knowledge of payroll accounting and general ledger reconciliations.


Experience with SOX controls and audit requirements.


Continuous improvement of payroll processes and operational efficiency.

  

 

\#LI\-OnSite

  

**Our Culture:**


Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. description:
**Career Area:**


Human Resources**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


Role Definition


The Talent Acquisition Partner is responsible for leading the full recruitment lifecycle and serving as a strategic advisor to hiring managers. This role provides expertise in talent acquisition, including workforce planning, candidate sourcing, assessment, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding coordination. The incumbent partners closely with business leaders to develop and execute hiring strategies that support organizational objectives while ensuring an exceptional candidate experience.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to develop and execute recruitment strategies aligned with organizational goals and workforce plans.
* Provide market intelligence, talent insights, and data\-driven recommendations to support hiring decisions.
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessment coordination, reference checks, offer negotiation, and onboarding support.
* Utilize Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Candidate Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, and advanced sourcing tools to identify and engage top talent.
* Build and maintain robust talent pipelines to support current and future hiring needs.
* Implement sourcing strategies focused on attracting diverse and high\-quality talent while optimizing time\-to\-fill and cost\-per\-hire metrics.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience through proactive communication and effective stakeholder management.
* Monitor recruitment metrics and leverage workforce analytics to improve hiring outcomes and process efficiencies.
* Promote employer branding initiatives and represent the organization positively in the talent marketplace.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, employment legislation, and recruitment best practices.


Skill Descriptors

### **Relationship Management**

**Knowledge of relationship management techniques and the ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with business leaders, candidates, vendors, and peers.**

### **Level: Extensive Experience**

* Communicates effectively with stakeholders regarding recruitment expectations, timelines, and deliverables.
* Influences hiring managers and business leaders through data\-driven recommendations.
* Conducts regular reviews of recruitment progress, challenges, and successes.
* Builds and maintains long\-term partnerships with key stakeholders and external vendors.
* Creates opportunities to educate hiring teams on talent market trends and recruitment best practices.
* Mentors and empowers others to establish collaborative and productive working relationships.

### **Customer/Market Focus**

**Understanding of evolving market trends and the ability to respond to customer and business needs in a manner that consistently adds value.**

### **Level: Working Knowledge**

* Identifies expressed and unexpressed business talent needs.
* Aligns recruiting strategies to critical business objectives.
* Develops methods to improve responsiveness and service delivery.
* Balances candidate quality, speed, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Escalates issues that could impact stakeholder satisfaction or business outcomes.

### **Recruitment Channel Management**

**Knowledge of selecting, implementing, and managing recruitment channels to support talent acquisition objectives.**

### **Level: Working Knowledge**

* Utilizes multiple recruitment channels to attract top talent.
* Identifies and manages cost\-effective sourcing partners and recruitment vendors.
* Evaluates recruitment channel effectiveness through analytics and hiring outcomes.
* Adheres to organizational recruitment standards and processes.
* Recommends and supports recruitment channel optimization initiatives.

### **Candidate Screening**

**Knowledge of effective candidate assessment and screening methodologies.**

### **Level: Extensive Experience**

* Screens candidates for professional, technical, and leadership roles.
* Ensures compliance with HR policies and recruitment standards throughout the screening process.
* Oversees candidate tracking and information management within recruitment systems.
* Coaches colleagues and hiring managers on effective interviewing and evaluation techniques.
* Leverages industry best practices to enhance candidate assessment quality.

### **Candidate Sourcing**

**Knowledge of sourcing techniques, methods, and tools to attract top talent.**

### **Level: Extensive Experience**

* Develops and executes multi\-channel sourcing strategies.
* Advises business leaders on talent availability and sourcing approaches.
* Recommends enhancements to sourcing tools, technologies, and processes.
* Ensures compliance with sourcing policies and ethical recruiting practices.
* Conducts workforce and talent market research to support strategic hiring decisions.
* Benchmarks sourcing strategies against industry best practices.

### **Staffing and Recruiting**

**Knowledge of staffing strategies, recruiting processes, and talent acquisition best practices.**

### **Level: Extensive Experience**

* Manages complex recruitment assignments across multiple business functions.
* Consults with stakeholders on workforce planning, recruitment strategies, and talent availability.
* Facilitates the adoption of recruitment best practices and process improvements.
* Evaluates and improves recruitment systems, tools, and methodologies.
* Coaches and mentors recruiters and hiring managers on effective hiring practices.
* Monitors industry trends and competitive talent landscapes.

### **Workforce Analytics**

**Knowledge of HR metrics, workforce trends, and reporting methodologies that support informed business decisions.**

### **Level: Working Knowledge**

* Analyzes recruitment and workforce data to identify trends and opportunities.
* Generates reports and dashboards to support leadership decision\-making.
* Tracks key recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-fill, quality of hire, and source effectiveness.
* Utilizes workforce analytics tools to improve hiring outcomes.
* Identifies and escalates data quality or reporting issues.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **8\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, Executive Search, or Human Resources.**
* Proven experience managing end\-to\-end recruitment for technical, professional, and leadership hiring.
* Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills.
* Experience using ATS, CRM platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing technologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume recruitment environment preferred.

The HR Technology Analyst is responsible for supporting the Hitachi Digital Human Resources technology ecosystem by maintaining HR systems, ensuring data integrity, managing system integrations, and optimizing business processes. * Participate in system upgrades, testing, and new feature implementations.

**Data Management \& Reporting**

* Maintain the integrity, accuracy, and consistency of employee and contingent workforce data across HR systems.
* Perform data audits, identify discrepancies, and implement corrective actions.
* Support data requests from HR, Payroll, Finance, and business leaders.

**Systems Integrations**

* Monitor and support integrations between HR systems and third\-party applications.
* Partner with IT and vendors to troubleshoot integration failures and resolve data transmission issues.
* Lead in implementing new integrations and enhancements to improve data flow and operational efficiency.
* Validate data mappings and perform end\-to\-end testing during implementation projects.

**Process Improvement**

* Analyze HR business processes and recommend technology solutions that improve efficiency, automation, and user experience.
* Document business requirements, process flows, and system configurations.
* Participate in cross\-functional projects involving HR technology implementations and enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes and reduce manual work.

**User Support \& Training**

* Serve as a subject matter expert for HR technology platforms.
* Provide technical support and guidance to HR users, managers, and employees.
* Create and manage user documentation, job aids, and training materials.
* Deliver training sessions for new system functionality and process updates.

**Compliance \& Governance**

* Ensure HR systems comply with organizational policies, data privacy regulations, and security standards.
* Support audits related to HR systems and employee data.
* Maintain documentation of system changes, configurations, and procedures.

**What you'll bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience supporting HRIS or HR technology platforms.
* Experience with Workday, Vndly or similar Human Capital Management (HCM) and Vendor Management Systems (VMS).
* Knowledge of HR business processes including recruiting, onboarding, core HR, payroll, benefits, and contingent workforce management.
* Experience supporting system integrations using APIs, EIBs, middleware, or other integration technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; experience with reporting and analytics tools is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Ability to work pro\-actively, independently and multi\-task on multiple projects with multiple deadlines

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting contingent workforce technologies such as VNDLY.
* Experience with HR system implementations or major enhancement projects.
* Knowledge of data governance, security administration, and compliance requirements.

**Core Competencies**

* HR Technology Administration
* Data Integrity \& Governance
* Systems Integration
* Business Process Analysis
* Process Improvement
* Customer Service
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Project Coordination

Success in this role is demonstrated by maintaining high\-quality HR data, ensuring reliable system performance and integrations, improving HR business processes through technology, delivering timely reporting and analytics, and providing exceptional support to HR stakeholders and end users.

**About HighLevel:**  

HighLevel is an AI\-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150\+ countries, fueling community\-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.  

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.  

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2\.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250\+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long\-term scalability.  

  

**Our People**  

With over 2,000 team members across 10\+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote\-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.  

  

**Our Impact**  

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1\.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

 Analyse feedback and identify areas to improve


### **Requirements**

* Recent graduate or final\-year student (HR, Business, Psychology, EdTech, or related fields)

**Job description**
===================

**Position Summary**

The HR Technology Integrations Analyst is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and optimizing the organization's Workday integration ecosystem. This role ensures the reliable exchange of HR, payroll, benefits, finance, and third\-party application data through the design, monitoring, troubleshooting, and enhancement of Workday integrations.


The analyst serves as a key liaison between Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Information Technology, and external vendors to ensure seamless data flow, system reliability, and compliance with organizational standards. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical expertise in Workday integration technologies, data mapping, troubleshooting, testing, and process automation, along with a solid understanding of HR business processes.


**Key Responsibilities**

**HR Systems Administration**

* Support the day\-to\-day administration, monitoring, and maintenance of Workday integrations and related data interfaces.
* Manage and troubleshoot integration failures, errors, and data discrepancies to ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain integration schedules, configurations, documentation, and support procedures.
* Participate in Workday releases, updates, and feature deployments, including impact assessments and testing activities.
* Collaborate with Workday functional teams to support changes affecting integrations and downstream systems.
* Support the day\-to\-day administration and maintenance of HR technology platforms, such as Workday, VNDLY, and other integrated HR systems, which includes supporting business processes, security roles, and workflows in accordance with business requirements.
* Troubleshoot system issues, coordinate resolutions, and escalate technical problems when appropriate.
* Participate in system upgrades, testing, and new feature implementations.

**Data Management \& Reporting**

* Perform data audits, identify discrepancies, and implement corrective actions.
* Support data requests from HR, Payroll, Finance, and business leaders.

**Systems Integrations**

* Monitor and support integrations between HR systems and third\-party applications.
* Partner with IT and vendors to troubleshoot integration failures and resolve data transmission issues.
* Lead in implementing new integrations and enhancements to improve data flow and operational efficiency.
* Validate data mappings and facilitate end\-to\-end testing during implementation projects.

**Process Improvement**

* Analyze HR business processes and recommend technology solutions that improve efficiency, automation, and user experience.
* Document business requirements, process flows, and system configurations.
* Participate in cross\-functional projects involving HR technology implementations and enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes and reduce manual work.

**User Support \& Training**

* Serve as a subject matter expert for Workday integration technologies and data flows.
* Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendors to resolve integration issues and support business objectives.
* Provide technical support and guidance to HR users, managers, and employees.
* Create and manage user documentation, job aids, and training materials.
* Communicate integration impacts, timelines, risks, and status updates effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Deliver training sessions for new system functionality and process updates.

**Compliance \& Governance**

* Implement processes to ensure HR systems comply with organizational policies, data privacy regulations, and security standards.
* Support audits related to HR systems and employee data.
* Maintain documentation of system changes, configurations, and procedures.

**what you'll bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience supporting Workday integrations, HRIS or HR technology platforms.
* Experience with Workday, VNDLY, or similar Human Capital Management (HCM) and Vendor Management Systems (VMS).
* Experience with Workday integration technologies, including EIB, Core Connectors, PECI, PICOF, Workday Studio, and/or Cloud Connect.
* Knowledge of HR business processes including recruiting, onboarding, core HR, payroll, benefits, and contingent workforce management.
* Experience supporting system integrations using APIs, EIBs, middleware, or other integration technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; experience with reporting and analytics tools is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Ability to work pro\-actively, independently and multi\-task on multiple projects with multiple deadlines

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Workday Studio, PECI, WECI, and custom integration knowledge.
* Experience supporting global HR and payroll integrations.
* Experience with HR system implementations or major enhancement projects.
* Knowledge of data governance, security administration, and compliance requirements.

* Integrations \& Error Handling
