We’re Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We’re crucial to the company’s strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast\-moving digital transformation market.  

  



Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full\-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real\-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.  

  



Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don’t expect you to ‘fit’ every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.


**Job description**
===================

**Position Summary**

The HR Technology Analyst is responsible for supporting the Hitachi Digital Human Resources technology ecosystem by maintaining HR systems, ensuring data integrity, managing system integrations, and optimizing business processes. This global role serves as a key liaison between Human Resources, Shared Services, Information Technology, Payroll, Finance, and external vendors to ensure HR technology solutions operate efficiently and support business objectives.


The ideal candidate has experience administering cloud\-based HR platforms such as Workday, Workday Studio, and related HR applications, with a strong understanding of HR data, reporting, integrations, and process improvement.


**Key Responsibilities**

**HR Systems Administration**

* Support the day\-to\-day administration and maintenance of HR technology platforms, such as Workday, Workday Studio, and other integrated HR systems, which includes supporting business processes, security roles, and workflows in accordance with business requirements.
* Troubleshoot system issues, coordinate resolutions, and escalate technical problems when appropriate.
* Participate in system upgrades, testing, and new feature implementations.

**Data Management \& Reporting**

* Maintain the integrity, accuracy, and consistency of employee and contingent workforce data across HR systems.
* Perform data audits, identify discrepancies, and implement corrective actions.
* Support data requests from HR, Payroll, Finance, and business leaders.

**Systems Integrations**

* Monitor and support integrations between HR systems and third\-party applications.
* Partner with IT and vendors to troubleshoot integration failures and resolve data transmission issues.
* Lead in implementing new integrations and enhancements to improve data flow and operational efficiency.
* Validate data mappings and perform end\-to\-end testing during implementation projects.

**Process Improvement**

* Analyze HR business processes and recommend technology solutions that improve efficiency, automation, and user experience.
* Document business requirements, process flows, and system configurations.
* Participate in cross\-functional projects involving HR technology implementations and enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes and reduce manual work.

**User Support \& Training**

* Serve as a subject matter expert for HR technology platforms.
* Provide technical support and guidance to HR users, managers, and employees.
* Create and manage user documentation, job aids, and training materials.
* Deliver training sessions for new system functionality and process updates.

**Compliance \& Governance**

* Ensure HR systems comply with organizational policies, data privacy regulations, and security standards.
* Support audits related to HR systems and employee data.
* Maintain documentation of system changes, configurations, and procedures.

**What you'll bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience supporting HRIS or HR technology platforms.
* Experience with Workday, Vndly or similar Human Capital Management (HCM) and Vendor Management Systems (VMS).
* Knowledge of HR business processes including recruiting, onboarding, core HR, payroll, benefits, and contingent workforce management.
* Experience supporting system integrations using APIs, EIBs, middleware, or other integration technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; experience with reporting and analytics tools is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Ability to work pro\-actively, independently and multi\-task on multiple projects with multiple deadlines

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting contingent workforce technologies such as VNDLY.
* Experience with HR system implementations or major enhancement projects.
* Knowledge of data governance, security administration, and compliance requirements.

**Core Competencies**

* HR Technology Administration
* Data Integrity \& Governance
* Systems Integration
* Business Process Analysis
* Process Improvement
* Customer Service
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Project Coordination

**Success Measures**

Success in this role is demonstrated by maintaining high\-quality HR data, ensuring reliable system performance and integrations, improving HR business processes through technology, delivering timely reporting and analytics, and providing exceptional support to HR stakeholders and end users.

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1724339
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Service line \- Position Title:**



At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.



We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.



Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  


**About Global Delivery Services**



Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.



Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.



Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.



Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.



Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  


**The Opportunity**



The role of an SAP HCM Technical consultant is to contribute towards end\-to\-end implementations of SAP HCM/ECP system for clients from all around the world especially the Americas, Australia, UK \& European countries. Key expectations for this role are to provide high quality results to these multinational teams, often to a tight deadline.

  


**Your Key Responsibilities**


* Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
* Analyse and propose solutions for requirements received from clients and Functional consultants
* Develop, document, and deliver solutions with utmost quality adhering to EY best practices
* Actively participate in entire life cycle of SAP HCM implementations like design, estimation, development, documentation, testing and take ownership wherever required
* Collaborate with experts, architects, and project managers to ensure highest standards of delivery within the stipulated timelines
* Drive improvements and innovations in development processes, methodologies, and technology
* Engage with the customers during different phases of product development to ensure success of the project

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Qualification: Any Graduate / Postgraduate
* 2 to 3 Years of experience in SAP as ABAP HR developer with good exposure to HCM Module
* Development experience in ABAP 7\.40 or higher is preferred
* Good understanding of Payroll processing in SAP HCM and experience in Payroll application development
* Good experience in Interface implementations using OData, IDocs, RFCs etc and Form developments.
* Expertise in various Enhancement Implementation options
* Knowledge in Integration techniques like PTP, BIB and Exposure to Employee Central Payroll, Payroll control centre and SF Employee Central will be an advantage
* Exposure to HANA Coding like CDS, AMDP will also be an advantage
* Ability to quickly understand customers business requirements and to generate, promote new and creative ideas.
* Strong interpersonal and good written \& oral communication skills.
* Team player, with the ability to multi\-task, flexible and can work under pressure.
* Commitment to continuous learning and proactively implement latest technologies.

  


**What we offer you**



At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.



Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

title: R&D Intern
description:
R\&D Intern

**Company:** THE CTC AGENCY  
**Department:** Research \& Development  
**Employment Type:** Internship  
**Work Mode:** Work From Home / Work From Office  
**Experience:** Freshers / Students / Entry\-Level Candidates

Role Overview

THE CTC AGENCY is looking for a curious and research\-oriented **R\&D Intern** to support the team in researching emerging technologies, tools, products, market trends, business ideas, and innovative solutions.

The intern will work on research, analysis, experimentation, documentation, and proof\-of\-concept activities across technology and business\-related projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct research on emerging technologies, software, platforms, tools, and digital solutions.
* Research new products, services, competitors, market trends, and industry developments.
* Identify potential technologies and solutions that can improve existing business processes.
* Collect, organize, and analyze information from reliable sources.
* Compare different technologies, platforms, tools, and solutions based on defined requirements.
* Assist in developing Proof of Concepts (PoCs), prototypes, and experimental solutions.
* Test new software, applications, APIs, platforms, and technology products.
* Support feasibility studies and technology evaluations.
* Conduct basic technical and functional experiments.
* Document research findings, observations, test results, and recommendations.
* Prepare research reports, comparison sheets, presentations, and internal documentation.
* Assist senior team members in innovation and product\-development initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and technology adoption.
* Monitor relevant technology and industry developments.
* Collaborate with technology, business, marketing, and operations teams when required.

Areas of Research

Depending on project requirements, the intern may work on:

* Artificial Intelligence \& Generative AI
* Web \& App Technologies
* SaaS Products
* Automation \& No\-Code/Low\-Code Platforms
* APIs \& Integrations
* Cloud Technologies
* Cybersecurity \& Data Protection
* Digital Marketing Technologies
* CRM \& HRMS Technologies
* FinTech \& Business Technology
* Emerging Software \& Platforms
* Market \& Competitor Research
* New Business/Product Ideas

Skills Required

* Strong research and analytical ability
* Logical and structured thinking
* Curiosity and willingness to explore new technologies
* Good internet research skills
* Basic understanding of technology and digital platforms
* Good written and verbal communication
* Data interpretation and comparison skills
* Documentation and report\-writing skills
* Presentation skills
* Problem\-solving ability
* Attention to detail
* Ability to learn independently

Technical Skills

Candidates with knowledge of any of the following will have an advantage:

* HTML, CSS, JavaScript or basic programming
* Python or any programming language
* APIs and JSON
* Databases
* AI tools and LLM technologies
* Cloud platforms
* Git/GitHub
* Automation tools
* WordPress/CMS
* Analytics and research tools
* Excel / Google Sheets
* PowerPoint / Google Slides

**Programming expertise is not mandatory** if the candidate demonstrates strong research, analytical, and learning capabilities.

Eligibility

* Students pursuing **Bachelor's or Master's degree** can apply.
* Graduates and postgraduates from **Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Management, Business, Commerce, Research, or related fields** may apply.
* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with personal projects, research work, technical experiments, certifications, or portfolios will be preferred.

Work ModeWork From Home

Candidates working remotely must have:

* Personal laptop/desktop
* Reliable internet connection
* Smartphone
* Ability to attend online meetings
* Comfortable working independently and submitting research/documentation within deadlines

Work From Office

Candidates will work collaboratively with the R\&D and cross\-functional teams and may participate in brainstorming sessions, testing, workshops, and project discussions.

Performance Parameters

The intern may be evaluated on:

* Quality of research
* Accuracy and reliability of information
* Analytical ability
* Research depth
* Quality of reports and documentation
* Problem\-solving
* Experimentation and PoC execution
* Timely completion of assignments
* Initiative and curiosity
* Ability to present findings
* Contribution to innovation and process improvement

What You Will Learn

* Professional research methodologies
* Technology evaluation
* Market and competitor analysis
* Product research
* Proof\-of\-concept development
* Emerging technology assessment
* Business problem analysis
* Technical documentation
* Innovation and product development
* Cross\-functional project collaboration

Career Opportunity

High\-performing interns may be considered for full\-time opportunities based on performance, skills, organizational requirements, and available positions.

**Potential Career Path:**

**R\&D Intern → R\&D Associate → R\&D Executive / Analyst → Senior R\&D Executive / Analyst → R\&D Lead → R\&D Manager**

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who **doesn't just search for answers but enjoys discovering how things work, testing new ideas, comparing possibilities, and finding better ways to solve problems.**

If you are curious about **technology, business, innovation, AI, products, and emerging trends**, this role can provide hands\-on exposure to real\-world R\&D activities at THE CTC AGENCY.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.

description:
**Executive Assistant / Secretary**

WovV Technologies \| Vadodara

**About WovV Technologies**

WovV Technologies (WovVTech) is a global AI\-first SaaS and technology company headquartered in Dubai, building intelligent software platforms that help enterprises digitize operations, automate workflows, and make data\-driven decisions. Since our inception in 2016, we have been empowering businesses across **50\+ countries** with cutting\-edge AI\-powered products and enterprise technology solutions.

Our mission is simple: **Build technology that makes businesses more productive, efficient, and intelligent.**

Today, WovVTech's solutions are deployed across 3,000\+ locations worldwide, serving leading enterprises in Shopping Centres, Retail, Airports, Banking, Healthcare, Real Estate, Entertainment, Hospitality, Oil \& Gas, and other industries. We work with global enterprises to solve complex operational challenges using Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, Analytics, Automation, and Open APIs.

**What We Build**

**Our portfolio of enterprise SaaS products includes:**

· **WovVRA** – AI\-powered Revenue Assurance \& Daily Sales Automation

· **WovVMaps** – Indoor Mapping, Navigation \& Location Intelligence

· **OKEN** – White\-labelled Customer Experience, Loyalty \& Engagement Platform

· **WovVLease** – Lease \& Commercial Management Platform

· **WovVBI** – Business Intelligence \& Executive Dashboards

· **WovVXM** – Experience Management (CX, NPS \& Feedback)

· **WovVIA** – Inspection \& Audit Platform

· **WovV360** – Tenant \& Enterprise Communication Platform

· **WovVVideo** – AI\-powered Video Analytics using CCTV

· Multiple AI agents and enterprise automation solutions built on our AI\-first technology platform.

**Why Join WovVTech?**

At WovVTech, you'll work on products that solve real\-world business problems at global scale. We combine the agility of a fast\-growing technology company with the opportunity to work on enterprise\-grade platforms used by some of the world's leading organizations.

**You'll have the opportunity to:**

· Build AI\-first enterprise products used globally

· Work with modern technologies including AI, Machine Learning, Cloud, Mobile, Analytics and Automation

· Collaborate with talented engineers, designers, product managers and business leaders

· Take ownership from idea to deployment

· Learn continuously through challenging projects across multiple industries

· Contribute to products that directly impact millions of consumers and thousands of businesses worldwide

**Our Culture**

We believe in ownership, innovation, customer obsession, continuous learning, and delivering excellence. Our teams are encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, challenge conventional approaches, and build products that create measurable business value.

We foster an environment where talented individuals can grow quickly, take responsibility, experiment with new ideas, and make a meaningful impact from day one.

**Global Presence**

· Headquarters: Dubai, UAE

· Global team across multiple countries

· Customers in 50\+ countries

· Hybrid, remote, and on\-site opportunities depending on the role.

We're looking for an Executive Assistant / Secretary for our Mumbai location. This role supports the CEO with sophisticated calendar management, administrative coordination, and stakeholder communication. Freshers with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.

1\. Provide sophisticated calendar management for the CEO.

2\. Work closely with the CEO to keep them well\-informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities, following up appropriately.

3\. Assist in coordinating the agenda of senior management team meetings. Prepare an account of the meetings and designate and follow up on assigned action items.

4\. Provide a "gatekeeper" and "gateway" role, creating win\-win situations for direct access to the CEO's time and office.

5\. Executive Support \& Calendar Management

**Administrative Tasks \& Documentation**

1\. Complete a broad variety of administrative tasks that facilitate the CEO's ability to effectively lead the organisation, including: assisting with special projects; designing and producing complex documents, reports, and presentations; collecting and preparing information for meetings with staff and outside parties; composing and preparing correspondence; maintaining contact lists; making travel arrangements; and completing expense and mileage reports.

2\. Draft correspondence and other documentation to the CEO's specification.

3\. Work on project tracking and be open to taking up varied tasks.

**Stakeholder \& Financial Coordination**

1\. Maintain a high degree of confidentiality with regard to issues concerning members of staff and all stakeholders. Respond positively with tact, sensitivity, and awareness to all stakeholders in relation to duties undertaken.

2\. Coordinate with bankers for various queries and resolutions.

**What We're Looking For**

1\. Proven prior experience as Executive Assistant or similar role (freshers with relevant training are welcome).

2\. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

3\. Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and email communications.

4\. Thrives in an intense, do\-it\-yourself, start\-up environment.

5\. Ability to work well within a cross\-functional team environment and diverse communities.

6\. Ability to switch gears at a moment's notice.

8\. Make appropriate, informed decisions regarding priorities and available time.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 We are sydon. Commerce should be about the brand you build, not the operation you survive. Most operators run their business across fragmented tools that don't talk to each other, each one finding problems and handing the work back. We're building sydon Symphony, the agentic operating system for commerce, where AI agents do that work themselves and Symphony orchestrates them into one system instead of a fragmented stack of tools. Eleven of those agents run in production today.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 As a Data Engineer at Sydon.ai, you will design, build, and maintain data pipelines that power our AI\-driven platform for Commerce. In this full\-time remote role, you will develop and optimize ETL processes, integrate data from multiple sources, and ensure data quality, reliability, and scalability. You will collaborate closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to model data, support analytics, and enable new features. Daily responsibilities include managing data warehousing solutions, monitoring data infrastructure, troubleshooting performance issues, and implementing best practices for security and compliance. You will contribute to continuous improvement of our data architecture and help shape standards for data engineering across the organization. Deeply passionate about data, owning the data model, pipelines using data governance tools is a must.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong skills in Data Engineering and building scalable data pipelines.
* Candidates should possess solid Data Modeling skills to design well\-structured and efficient datasets.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes and Data Warehousing solutions.
* Candidates should possess capabilities in Data Analytics to support reporting, dashboards, and data\-driven decisions.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and modern data stack tools is beneficial.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering (such as Python or Scala) is preferred.
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration and version control tools, and adherence to data security and privacy best practices are advantageous.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work effectively in a remote, cross\-functional team environment with clear communication and ownership of deliverables.



  





 Remote (India) · Full\-time, Flexible IST with a 6:30\-9:30 pm IST overlap window
 



  





 Start: immediate. If you are a fresher and hungry to learn, feel free to apply as well.

description:

 We are hiring OpenShift Administrators for a large on\-premise private cloud estate at a client data centre in Noida. You will provide first\-line support for a production Red Hat OpenShift container platform running live workloads, within an ITIL\-aligned support model with defined SLAs.
 



**Please read before applying** 



* This is an
 **onsite** 
 role at a client location in Noida. It is not remote or hybrid.
* The role runs on
 **24x7 rotational shifts, including nights and weekends.** 
 Willingness to work rotational shifts is mandatory and will be confirmed at screening.
* You must be based in Delhi NCR or able to relocate.



**What you'll do** 



* Monitor cluster, node and pod health; acknowledge and act on alerts within defined SLA

* Monitor persistent volume claims, storage capacity and certificate expiry; raise issues before they become incidents

* Working knowledge of core Kubernetes and OpenShift objects — pods, deployments, deployment configs, services, routes, config maps, secrets, persistent volume claims
* Comfortable with the oc and kubectl command line; able to read pod and container logs and describe output to isolate a problem
* Understanding of container fundamentals — images, registries, container runtime behaviour
* Solid Linux administration fundamentals on RHEL or CentOS
* Basic networking — DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, ingress and routing concepts
* Experience with a ticketing tool such as ServiceNow, Remedy or Jira Service Management

**Nice to have** 



* Red Hat certification — RHCSA, or Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration

**Other details** 



* Full\-time employment; resources are deployed onsite at the client location

title: Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert
description:
**Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert (AI Security)**
**About The Role**
 What if your hacking skills could directly shape how safe and secure AI systems are for millions of users worldwide? We're looking for Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Experts to probe, attack, and stress\-test AI\-powered applications and infrastructure — identifying vulnerabilities before bad actors do.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your offensive security expertise meets the cutting edge of artificial intelligence. You'll work on high\-impact projects that directly improve the security posture of AI systems used at scale.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Conduct penetration tests against AI\-powered applications, APIs, and infrastructure to uncover security vulnerabilities
* Identify and exploit weaknesses in AI/ML pipelines, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning vectors, and authentication flaws
* Perform web application, network, and API security assessments using industry\-standard tools and methodologies
* Simulate real\-world attack scenarios — from reconnaissance through exploitation and post\-exploitation
* Document findings in clear, structured reports with severity ratings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance
* Evaluate AI\-specific attack surfaces including adversarial inputs, jailbreaks, and data exfiltration risks
* Stay current with emerging AI security threats and contribute insights to improve testing methodologies
* Work independently on task\-based engagements on your own schedule


**Who You Are**
* Experienced penetration tester with a strong understanding of offensive security principles and methodologies (OWASP, PTES, MITRE ATT\&CK)
* Proficient with industry\-standard tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, or equivalent
* Solid understanding of web application security, network security, and API security testing
* Able to think like an attacker — creative, persistent, and methodical in finding what others miss
* Strong written communication skills — you can translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports
* Self\-motivated and reliable when working independently without direct supervision
* Comfortable working across diverse technology stacks and environments


**Nice to Have**
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, CEH, GPEN, GXPN, or eWPT
* Experience with AI/ML security testing — adversarial machine learning, prompt injection, LLM red\-teaming
* Background in red teaming, bug bounty programs, or CTF competitions
* Familiarity with cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security
* Programming or scripting skills in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar
* Knowledge of secure development practices and DevSecOps workflows
* Experience conducting security assessments in compliance\-driven environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.)


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI security projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with access to high\-impact, intellectually challenging engagements
* Be at the forefront of AI security — a rapidly growing field with massive demand
* Sharpen your skills against novel AI\-specific attack surfaces that few security professionals have encountered
* Contribute directly to making AI systems safer and more trustworthy for users worldwide
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

* Tally or other accounting software knowledge.

* Experience in IT/software company accounting or tender documentation.

Training \& Development

The company will provide training on:

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Audit Support \& Execution**

* Assist auditors during **onsite** audits: meeting notes, evidence walkthroughs, and coordination with client stakeholders.

**Evidence Collection \& Documentation**

* Collect and organize evidence (policies, SOPs, logs, tickets, screenshots, configurations, training records).
* Maintain evidence trackers and ensure proper naming, versioning, and traceability.
* Help map evidence to standard/framework requirements (clauses, controls, Trust Services Criteria, regulatory requirements).

**Gap Assessment \& Reporting**

* Support identification of gaps, observations, OFIs, and nonconformities with clear references.
* Draft sections of audit deliverables: checklists, working papers, meeting minutes, and summary notes.
* Assist with corrective action follow\-ups: tracking CAPA status and closure evidence.

**Tools \& Coordination**

* Update audit trackers, risk registers, SoA/controls mapping sheets, and project documentation repositories.
* Coordinate with internal teams for scheduling, logistics, and documentation completeness.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow internal information security policies at all times.

**Standards / Framework Exposure (During Internship)**

You may work across one or more of the following (based on project allocation):

* **ISO/IEC 27001:2022** – Information Security Management Systems
* **ISO/IEC 42001:2023** – AI Management Systems (AIMS)
* **ISO/IEC 27701:2019** – Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)
* **SOC 2** – Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Privacy)
* **HIPAA** – Security/Privacy Rule alignment (as applicable)
* **GDPR** – Privacy compliance assessment support

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**

* Interest in AI governance/AI risk and model lifecycle basics (helpful for ISO 42001 projects).

**Internship Outcomes / Learning**

* Understanding how certification/assurance audits are conducted and how evidence is evaluated.
* Improved professional writing: working papers, checklists, summaries, and CAPA tracking.
* Exposure to multi\-framework compliance expectations across security, privacy, and AI governance.

**Professional Expectations**

* Be punctual and dependable for onsite schedules and client meetings.
* Demonstrate attention to detail and a willingness to learn.

title: IoT / Embedded Systems Enginee
description:
**Company Description** 
 :
 



 SnifferBots is a Pune\-based IoT hardware company on a mission to stop electrical fires before they start.
 



  
 



 Electrical control panels and switchgear are protected against overcurrent, overvoltage, and short\-circuits — but not against the slow build\-up of heat, humidity, and gas that actually causes most panel fires. SnifferBots closes that gap. Our sensing units install inside each feeder compartment, continuously monitor conditions in real time, and can proactively trip a feeder before a fault becomes a fire, with live alerts on a connected app.
 



  
 



 We're a small, hands\-on team building hardware that gets deployed inside real electrical infrastructure, and we're now developing our next\-generation device. If you want to build safety\-critical technology that protects people, equipment, and uptime, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 SnifferBots builds IoT hardware that detects the early warning signs of electrical fires — abnormal heat, humidity, and gas — inside control panels and switchgear, and can proactively trip a feeder before a fault becomes a fire. We're building our next\-generation device and looking for a hands\-on engineer to help take it from prototype to product.
 



  
 



 What you'll do:
 



 • Build and iterate on hardware prototypes (ESP32\-based) integrating temperature, humidity, and gas sensors
 



 • Write and maintain firmware in C/C\+\+ (Arduino framework): sensor logic, alarm thresholds, relay control, OTA updates, offline data buffering
 



 • Integrate the device with a cloud database (Firebase) for real\-time and historical data logging
 



 • Build automated SMS (MSG91\) and email alerts for warning/critical conditions
 



 • Debug across the full stack — sensors, firmware, and cloud connectivity
 



 • Work directly with the founder on design decisions and the path to a manufacturable product
 



  
 



**What you bring** 
 :
 



 • Solid C/C\+\+ programming; hands\-on with the Arduino IDE and ESP32 (or ESP8266/STM32\)
 



 • Practical experience with I2C, SPI, UART, and WiFi
 



 • Basic electronics skills — reading datasheets, breadboard debugging, multimeter use
 



 • Some exposure to cloud/IoT platforms or REST APIs (Firebase, AWS IoT, ThingsBoard, or similar) — academic or personal projects count
 



 • A degree (or final\-year standing) in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or a related field
 



  
 



**Good to have** 
 :
 



 • A personal or academic project combining ESP32/Arduino \+ sensors \+ a cloud backend — show us what you've built
 



 • Basic PCB design exposure (KiCad, EasyEDA, or Eagle)
 



 • Familiarity with RTOS concepts, MQTT, or BLE
 



  
 



**Why join us** 
 :
 



 • Full ownership of a real product from prototype to launch — not one layer of a large team's stack
 



 • Direct mentorship and collaboration with the founder
 



 • Build safety\-critical hardware that ships into real electrical installations
 



  
 



**Experience level** 
 : 1–3 years — strong fresher project portfolios welcome
 



 Compensation: 4 to 6Lacs PA
 



  
 



 To apply: send your resume plus links to any relevant projects (GitHub, portfolio, or a short demo video) to info@snifferbots.com with the subject line "IoT Engineer — SnifferBots."

This role centers on Qualcomm networking SoCs and the prplOS/prplMesh open\-source stack, contributing across system services, network stacks, WiFi mesh features, and the App and Web GUI configuration interfaces that power our connected home products.
   

  

 You will work at the intersection of low\-level embedded systems and modern mesh networking, partnering closely with hardware teams to validate radio performance and deliver reliable, high\-performance WiFi experiences to millions of NETGEAR customers worldwide.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and integrate prplMesh components across Qualcomm, Broadcom, and MediaTek\-based SoCs.
* Apply AI\-centric design practices to WiFi software development (Prompt → Context → Harness engineering).
* Partner with the hardware team to validate radio performance and mesh stability.
* Interface with mesh APIs, WiFi drivers, and the 1905\.1 protocol stack.
* Implement configuration and telemetry reporting through the App and Web GUI.
* Provide technical leadership across the networking stack, mesh stack, and control panel development.
* Conduct functional and performance testing, drive bug fixes, and support customer escalations.

* Familiarity with Qualcomm, Broadcom, and MediaTek QSDK, OpenWrt, or Yocto\-based systems.
* Solid understanding of wireless networking, 802\.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be, mesh networking, and QoS.
* Strong understanding of Linux kernel and user\-space interactions.
* Working knowledge of bridging, Ethernet, VLAN, TCP/UDP, IPv4/IPv6, DHCP, NAT, DNS, and routing protocols.
* Familiarity with firewalling, iptables/nftables, and traffic shaping.
* Working knowledge of network functions for router or gateway products.
* Experience with 802\.11 platforms and prplOS/prplMesh architecture and development.
* Experience profiling WiFi performance including RSSI/SNR metrics, DFS, AWGN, and channel steering.

The candidate will work **under the supervision of the Admin Manager** and will be responsible for timely follow\-up, accurate documentation and coordination with internal departments.

Key ResponsibilitiesOrder Processing \& Execution

* Receive and process customer **Purchase Orders / Work Orders**.
* Check basic PO details such as product, quantity, rate, GST, delivery terms and other requirements.
* Update order details in Excel/system and maintain the **Order Execution Tracker**.
* Coordinate internally with **Sales, Accounts, Billing, Stores, Logistics and Service** teams for order execution.
* Track orders from **PO receipt to final completion**.
* Follow up on dispatch, delivery, installation and commissioning activities.
* Maintain delivery challans, installation reports, commissioning reports and other completion documents.
* Ensure timely follow\-up of pending order\-related activities.

Invoice \& Portal Activities

* Coordinate with the Billing team for invoice preparation.
* Verify invoice details against the relevant PO/WO.
* **Upload invoices on GeM and other applicable customer portals.**
* Upload required supporting documents along with invoices.
* Maintain records of invoice submissions and acknowledgements.
* Track invoice status and follow up on pending or rejected invoices.
* Coordinate internally for corrections and re\-submission wherever required.

Documentation \& Record Management

* Maintain proper soft and hard copies of order\-related documents.
* Maintain and regularly update order execution trackers.
* Ensure all documents are properly filed and easily retrievable.
* Maintain records of PO, delivery, installation, commissioning, invoice and order closure documents.

Coordination \& Follow\-up

* Coordinate with internal departments for timely completion of assigned activities.
* Follow up regularly on pending deliveries, installations, invoices and documentation.
* Keep the **Admin Manager** updated regarding pending activities, delays or issues.
* Assist in preparing daily, weekly and monthly operational reports.
* Perform other operational tasks assigned by the reporting manager.

Skills Required

* Basic knowledge of **Tally**, **MS Excel, MS Word and Email**.
* Good communication and follow\-up skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good documentation and data\-entry skills.
* Good coordination and organizational skills.
* Basic computer and internet skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Willingness to learn and take responsibility.

Eligibility

* Graduate in any discipline.
* **Freshers are welcome to apply.**
* 0–2 years of experience in order processing, back\-office, operations or sales coordination will be an advantage.
* Experience with **GeM/customer portal invoice uploading** will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be **organized, responsible, detail\-oriented and good at follow\-up**. The candidate should be comfortable working with **Excel, emails, online portals and documentation** and should have a willingness to learn business operations and order execution processes.

**Salary:** ₹16,000\-20,000 per month, depending on candidate's experience, skills and current salary.

Pay: ₹16,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Field Sales Executive – Dealer Development \& Secondary Sales (Neycer Sanitaryware)**

**Location**

Kanchipuram (Tamil Nadu)

Reporting To

Sales Manager – Neycer Sanitaryware

About Neycer

Neycer is one of India's established sanitaryware brands, offering a wide range of sanitaryware and bathroom solutions. We are looking for energetic and result\-oriented field sales professionals to expand our dealer network, increase market penetration, and drive secondary sales across assigned territories.

Job Summary

The Field Sales Executive will be responsible for regularly visiting dealers, retailers, plumbers, builders, contractors, and influencers in the assigned territory to generate sales for Neycer products.

The role requires identifying and onboarding new dealers, supporting existing dealers in improving sales, generating enquiries, and ensuring consistent secondary sales growth.

This is a performance\-driven role with a fixed salary and attractive incentives linked directly to business generated.

Key Responsibilities

**Market Visits \& Relationship Building**

· Conduct daily market visits within the assigned territory.

· Meet sanitaryware dealers, retailers, distributors, plumbers, builders, contractors, and architects.

· Promote Neycer sanitaryware products and create brand awareness.

· Build and maintain strong relationships with channel partners.

Dealer \& Retailer Onboarding

· Identify potential dealers and retailers for Neycer products.

· Explain dealership opportunities and product advantages.

· Assist in dealer onboarding and activation.

· Expand Neycer's market presence in assigned locations.

Secondary Sales Generation

· Generate orders through existing dealers and retailers.

· Increase product movement from dealer counters.

· Follow up on enquiries and convert them into sales.

· Support dealers in achieving higher monthly sales volumes.

· Monitor stock availability and coordinate replenishment requirements.

Influencer Engagement

· Develop relationships with plumbers, contractors, architects, and builders.

· Generate project leads and referral business.

· Promote Neycer products for residential and commercial projects.

Market Intelligence

· Gather information on competitor activities, pricing, schemes, and product launches.

· Identify opportunities for market expansion and business growth.

· Provide regular feedback on customer requirements and market trends.

Reporting

· Submit daily and weekly market visit reports.

· Maintain records of dealer visits, enquiries, orders, and business generated.

· Track dealer performance and sales achievements.

Eligibility Criteria Education

· Any Graduate / Diploma Holder.

· Candidates with experience in sanitaryware, tiles, building materials, hardware, plumbing products, paints, electricals, or FMCG sales preferred.

Experience

· Freshers with strong field sales aptitude can apply.

· 1–5 years of field sales experience preferred.

Skills Required

· Strong communication and persuasion skills.

· Ability to build dealer relationships.

· Self\-motivated and target\-oriented.

· Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

· Basic reporting and smartphone usage skills.

**Compensation Structure Fixed Salary**

**₹10,000 per month Performance Incentives based on performance**

**Additional incentives will be paid based on:**

· Value of sales generated.

· Number of active dealers onboarded.

· Secondary sales achieved through dealers.

· New customer acquisitions.

· Project enquiries converted into business.

Earnings Potential

**No upper limit on incentives.**

High\-performing candidates can significantly increase their monthly earnings through successful dealer development and sales generation activities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

· Daily market visits completed.

· Number of dealers/retailers onboarded.

· Monthly sales generated.

· Secondary sales growth.

· Active dealer engagement.

· New project leads generated.

· Collection of market intelligence.

Preferred Candidate

**We are looking for individuals who:**

· Enjoy meeting customers and travelling in the market.

· Have a passion for sales and business development.

· Can independently generate enquiries and close business.

· Are eager to grow with a leading sanitaryware brand.

**Join Neycer and become a key contributor in expanding one of India's trusted sanitaryware brands across South India.**

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Valid two\-wheeler driving license.

title: Marketing Engineer
description:
We are looking for a **Marketing Executive** to support our business development and marketing activities in the **STP, WTP, ETP, RO and wastewater treatment** sector.

The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a willingness to learn technical products, and an interest in **B2B sales and business development**. The role will involve identifying new business opportunities, meeting clients and consultants, following up on enquiries, and supporting the sales team in generating new projects.

Key Responsibilities :

**1\. Business Development**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities for **STP, WTP, ETP, RO and related water\-treatment solutions**.
* Identify potential customers through market research, online platforms, industry databases, references, meeting consultants, architects and networking.
* Generate leads and maintain a systematic database of prospective clients.
* Make regular follow\-up calls, emails and client visits.
* Develop relationships with builders, developers, architects, consultants, MEP consultants, facility management companies, industries and institutions.

**2\. Client \& Consultant Interaction**

* Visit clients, consultants, project sites and offices as required.
* Understand the client's basic requirements and coordinate with the technical team for suitable solutions.
* Introduce the company's products, technologies and capabilities to prospective customers.
* Maintain regular communication with existing and potential clients.
* Participate in meetings, presentations and technical discussions with support from the technical team.

**3\. Enquiry \& Tender Support**

* Track incoming enquiries and coordinate with the estimation/technical team for quotations.
* Follow up on submitted quotations and commercial proposals.
* Assist in collecting project information such as capacity, technology requirement, specifications, BOQ and project timelines.
* Monitor tenders and upcoming projects relevant to the company's business.
* Maintain records of enquiries, quotations, follow\-ups and order status.

**4\. Marketing Activities**

* Support digital and offline marketing activities.
* Assist in preparing company presentations, product profiles, brochures and marketing material.
* Support participation in exhibitions, conferences, seminars and industry events.
* Coordinate with the management for LinkedIn, email marketing and other B2B marketing initiatives.

**5\. Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate with the **Sales, Design, Estimation, Projects and O\&M teams**.
* Ensure that customer requirements are properly communicated internally.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, enquiries, meetings and follow\-ups.
* Provide regular updates to the reporting manager on business development activities.

**Educational Qualification**

* B.E./B.Tech – preferably Civil, Mechanical, Environmental, Chemical or related engineering disciplines
* B.Sc./M.Sc. – preferably Environmental Science, Chemistry or related fields
* MBA – preferably Marketing / Sales / Business Development
* Other relevant technical or management qualifications may also be considered

**Experience:**

* Freshers are welcome
* 1–2 years of experience in B2B sales, marketing, business development, infrastructure, construction, MEP, environmental services or water\-treatment industry will be an advantage

**Preferred**

* Basic understanding of **STP, WTP, ETP, RO, MBR, MBBR, SBR or wastewater treatment**
* Previous experience in technical sales or B2B sales
* Experience dealing with consultants, contractors, builders or industrial clients
* Knowledge of lead generation through LinkedIn, email and other digital platforms
* Valid driving licence and willingness to travel
* Willing to travel within Bangalore and occasionally outside Bangalore

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Franchise Development Manager
description:
Franchise Development Manager – Target\-Oriented Job

**Company:** Shri Bharti Gold and Diamonds Private Limited  
**Position:** Franchise Development Manager  
**Location:** Bihar – Multiple Locations  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Job Nature:** Target\-Oriented / Business Development

Job Description

We are looking for highly motivated and result\-oriented **Franchise Development Managers** to expand our franchise network across Bihar. The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential franchise investors, generating leads, conducting business presentations, developing new franchise partners, and achieving assigned monthly and annual franchise acquisition targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and acquire new franchise partners across Bihar.
* Generate and manage franchise investment leads.
* Conduct meetings, presentations, and business discussions with prospective investors.
* Explain the company's franchise model, investment plans, products, and business opportunities.
* Achieve assigned **monthly, quarterly, and annual franchise acquisition targets**.
* Develop strong relationships with investors, business owners, and potential franchisees.
* Conduct market research and identify new locations for franchise expansion.
* Coordinate with management for franchise onboarding and documentation.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with prospective franchise partners.
* Submit daily/weekly/monthly sales and franchise development reports.
* Travel within Bihar as required for business development activities.

Target\-Oriented Performance

This is a **strictly target\-oriented position**. Performance will be evaluated primarily on:

* Qualified franchise leads generated
* Franchise meetings and presentations conducted
* Franchise agreements completed
* New franchise partners acquired
* Investment/business volume generated
* Monthly and quarterly target achievement

Experience

**Required Experience: 2–5 years** in Business Development, Sales, Franchise Development, Real Estate Sales, Financial Products, Retail Expansion, or a related field.

**Freshers with exceptional communication and sales ability may also be considered for suitable positions.**

Compensation \& Benefits

* Attractive fixed salary based on experience and capability
* **Performance\-based incentives**
* **Achievement bonus for target completion**
* Additional incentives for exceptional performance
* Travel/conveyance support as per company policy
* Career growth opportunities
* Opportunity to work with a rapidly expanding jewellery and franchise business

Required Skills

* Excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Strong sales and business development ability
* Investor handling and relationship management
* Target\-oriented mindset
* Leadership and team\-building skills
* Willingness to travel across Bihar
* Ability to work independently and deliver measurable results

Career Growth

High\-performing candidates will have opportunities for promotion to **Senior Franchise Development Manager, Regional Manager, Zonal Manager, and other senior business development positions** based on performance and franchise expansion achievements.

**If you are ambitious, target\-driven, and passionate about business development, join Shri Bharti Gold and Diamonds Private Limited and become a part of our expanding franchise network across Bihar.**

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹22,500\.00 \- ₹31,500\.00 per month

Education:

* Secondary(10th Pass) (Preferred)

Experience:

* Client Management: 1 year (Preferred)
* total work: 1 year (Preferred)
* Marketing: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Product Associate
description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Product Associate will independently own and manage assigned product features and workflows for Duruper.com. This role is ideal for a hands\-on product professional who can translate business needs into clear, actionable product specifications and work closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality outcomes. The position offers strong growth potential toward a full Product Manager role.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  




* Own and manage assigned product features or functional areas end\-to\-end
* Analyze business problems and convert them into clear product requirements
* Create, maintain, and update Product Requirement Documents (PRDs)
* Define detailed user flows, edge cases, and acceptance criteria
* Write user stories, tasks, and subtasks with clear definitions of done
* Manage and track work items using Jira
* Maintain structured product documentation in Notion (PRDs, specs, decisions)
* Collaborate with engineering, design, QA, and business stakeholders
* Coordinate requirement discussions and clarifications during development
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validate delivered features
* Capture user feedback and operational inputs to propose product improvements



  





**Mandatory Requirements** 




  




* 1–3 years of experience in Product Management, Associate Product, or Business Analyst roles
* Proven experience in writing PRDs, user stories, and functional specifications
* Hands\-on experience with Jira for task and issue tracking
* Strong documentation skills using Notion or Confluence
* Solid understanding of Agile product development methodologies
* Ability to work independently on defined problem statements
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and structured thinking approach

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **Junior Site Engineer** to assist in the execution and supervision of construction activities at our **IIT Bhubaneswar** project. title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**Job Summary:** 




 The Technical Project Manager (TPM) orchestrates complex, multi\-stakeholder initiatives across research, development, deployment, and ecosystem partnerships. You’ll bridge technical teams, academia, government partners, and commercial stakeholders—ensuring projects deliver on scope, timeline, and quality while proactively identifying risks and driving continuous improvement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 • Project Planning \& Execution
 



 \- Define scope, objectives, milestones, and success metrics with technical leads
 



 \- Develop comprehensive project plans, timelines, and resource allocation strategies
 



 \- Establish clear deliverables, dependencies, and critical path items
 



  





 • Project Monitoring \& Control
 



 \- Set up real\-time dashboards and KPI tracking using project management tools (Jira, Asana)
 



 \- Monitor project health: budget, timeline, resources, scope, quality
 



 \- Generate status reports with variance analysis and trend identification
 



 \- Track blockers, dependencies, and risks with proactive resolution

 \- Identify potential risks early through stakeholder engagement
 



 \- Maintain risk registers and develop mitigation/contingency plans
 



 \- Escalate critical issues with context, severity, and recommended solutions
 



 \- Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives

 \- Act as single point of contact for cross\-functional teams and external partners
 



 \- Facilitate collaboration between researchers, engineers, DevOps, data teams, and business units
 



 \- Manage competing priorities and negotiate resource allocation

 \- Conduct process audits to identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks
 



 \- Analyze root causes of delays; recommend improvements
 



 \- Identify resource gaps (skills, tools, infrastructure)
 



 \- Drive adoption of best practices across teams

 \- Create automated reporting systems (burn\-down charts, velocity reports, forecasts)
 



 \- Develop data\-driven recommendations for stakeholders

**Minimum Qualifications and Experience:** 




 • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 7\+ years of project management experience, with 4\+ years managing technical/R\&D projects with exposure to Generative AI/LLMs, Indian\-language or multilingual NLP, government\-funded or PPP projects, and academic research workflows.
 



  





**Required Expertise:** 




 • Proven track record with multi\-stakeholder initiatives
 



 • Expertise in Agile/Waterfall/hybrid methodology (PMP, CSM, or PRINCE2 certification preferred)

 • Strong cross\-functional team management (engineers, researchers, external partners)
 



 • Working knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC)
 



 • Familiarity with AI/ML project workflows and research timelines (preferred)
 



 • Ability to translate technical requirements into project plans
 



 • Proficiency in data analysis tools: Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Power BI
 



 • Comfortable working with command\-line tools, APIs, and basic Git
 



 • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts to diverse audiences
 



 • Proactive problem\-solving with early issue identification and solution\-oriented escalation
 



 • Strong stakeholder management skills, including navigating competing priorities and building consensus
 



 • Strong attention to detail in maintaining documentation and compliance requirements

title: Scrum Master
job_function: Quality Assurance, Information Technology, and Engineering
description:
**IT Scrum Master – Data \& AI Solutions CoE**
**PURPOSE AND SCOPE**
 The IT Scrum Master in the Data \& AI Solutions CoE provides delivery leadership and Agile coaching to one or more data, analytics, and AI\-focused technology teams. This role enables the successful execution of data\-driven initiatives that support the organization’s business strategy and digital transformation objectives.
   

  

 The Scrum Master ensures teams adhere to Agile and Scrum practices while delivering high\-quality data and AI products, including analytics platforms, machine learning models, and data pipelines. The role is responsible for maintaining predictable delivery, managing dependencies, and ensuring alignment to scope, timelines, and quality expectations within data and AI programs.
   

  

 The Scrum Master monitors team progress, promotes transparency across data initiatives, facilitates risk management, and ensures effective communication and escalation within the Data \& AI CoE and broader stakeholder community.
   

  

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
* Serve as Scrum Master for Data \& AI Agile teams, providing leadership, facilitation, and coaching to ensure successful delivery of data products and AI solutions.
* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, tailored to data and analytics workflows.
* Coach teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum practices, and continuous improvement within a data\-driven and AI\-centric environment.
* Partner with Product Owners, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers to support backlog prioritization, refinement, and clarity of user stories, including data requirements, model objectives, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify, track, and proactively remove impediments related to data dependencies, data quality issues, infrastructure constraints, and model lifecycle challenges.
* Promote transparency by tracking and communicating Agile metrics such as velocity, model delivery cycles, data pipeline readiness, and sprint progress.
* Support Agile planning and execution while ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance, AI standards, and delivery frameworks.
* Establish and maintain effective communication plans, ensuring timely updates to stakeholders on data initiatives, analytics outcomes, and AI model progress.
* Facilitate cross\-team collaboration across data engineering, data science, analytics, and platform teams to manage dependencies and shared risks.
* Contribute to the development and adoption of Agile best practices specifically tailored for Data \& AI delivery within the CoE.
* Apply sound judgment to resolve complex delivery challenges involving data integration, model development, and analytical workflows.
* Mentor and support less\-experienced Scrum Masters or team members within the Data \& AI CoE.
* Escalate risks, impediments, or delivery concerns related to data availability, model performance, or platform constraints to leadership when necessary.
* Ensure compliance with the Code of Business Conduct, data governance policies, AI ethics guidelines, and all applicable company procedures and regulations.
* Assist with additional Data \& AI initiatives and CoE\-related duties as assigned.


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree required; Advanced Degree (Data Science, Analytics, AI, or related field) will be an added advantage .
* 5–8 years of related IT experience, including hands\-on experience supporting Agile teams in data, analytics, or AI/ML environments.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or equivalent Agile certification required or strongly preferred.
* Proven knowledge of Agile frameworks, Scrum practices, and SDLC methodologies, with exposure to DataOps, MLOps, or Analytics delivery models preferred.
* Experience working within a Data \& AI Center of Excellence, analytics practice, or enterprise data platform environment.
* Familiarity with data engineering concepts, machine learning lifecycle, analytics platforms, and cloud data ecosystems is highly desirable.
* Strong organizational and facilitation skills with the ability to manage multiple data initiatives and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work creatively, analytically, and independently in a fast\-paced, data\-driven problem\-solving environment.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across data engineers, data scientists, business stakeholders, and leadership teams.
* Effective conflict resolution and problem\-solving capabilities, especially in complex data environments.
* Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills.
* Ability to drive Agile maturity and sustain change within Data \& AI transformation initiatives.
* Strong business acumen; understanding of how data and AI drive business value is preferred.
* Experience in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, financial services) and familiarity with data compliance standards is a plus.

description:
The Manager, Human Relations will be responsible for establishing the HR function at the project site, ensuring that all human resource activities are aligned with the company’s core values and business needs. This role will involve setting up HR systems, handling early\-stage recruitment, and building a strong foundation for the company’s future workforce in line with the company’s values and objectives.
 



  





**Job Description** 



* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment activities to support the growth of the new operation.
* Partner with business leaders to understand hiring needs and support workforce planning initiatives.
* Build and implement HR policies, processes, and systems in line with company standards and best practices.
* Manage employee onboarding, performance management, employee relations, and other core HR activities.
* Act as a trusted HR advisor to managers and employees on people\-related matters.
* Ensure compliance with local labor laws, regulations, and company policies.
* Drive employee engagement, learning and development, and culture\-building initiatives.
* Support the creation of a positive, collaborative, and high\-performing work environment.



  





**Job Requirements** 



* MBA or post\-graduate qualification in Human Resources or a related field.
* 5\-10 years of experience in HR, with specific experience in either Business Partnering or Recruitment.
* Proven experience in establishing HR functions in a new project or organization is highly desirable.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to develop and implement HR systems and processes effectively and in alignment with company values.
* Problem\-solving and conflict resolution skills, with the ability to address employee concerns and foster a positive work environment.
* Strong team player with the ability to adapt to a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Results\-oriented with a focus on building a solid HR foundation while fostering a collaborative and inclusive work culture.
* A passion for developing talent and promoting company values throughout the employee lifecycle.

title: Employee Relations Manager
description:
**Description**
 Employee Success is made up of HR professionals, Recruiters, Operations, and Coordinators that come together to continue to build out Salesforce. In Employee Success, we strive to bring on top talent and continue to build out our organization with the Aloha style treatment. Whether we are recruiting the next great candidate, refining our operations, we strive to provide the royal treatment and continue to build a great organization.
   

  

 Role Description
   

  

 The Employee Relations Manager provides Employee Relations and Performance Management expertise, specifically workplace investigations, case management and consultation, within a centralised, Employee Relations (ER) function, for India. Responsible for ongoing development of; and leveraging common consistent practices and processes to ensure a fair and consistent approach across clients. Handles complex, high\-risk or sensitive employee relations cases and can establish strong working relationships with local HR and Leaders. Reports to the Senior Director, Employee Relations APAC.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 To be successful in this role you will be a great relationship builder at all levels; connect and build trust to ensure employees feel comfortable to discuss matters in a safe \& neutral environment; managing your time, work independently with minimal supervision, and respond promptly to communications as a priority; pay attention to the detail and accuracy of data while remaining calm under pressure; propose solutions and recommend plans for improvement that always align with best practice in company policy, values, guidelines, and respective country’s legislation compliance. Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Conduct ER investigations to include: gathering and analyzing facts, applying relevant laws, policies, and past practice to reach conclusions and recommend management action.
* Work closely and Partner with internal Employment Attorneys, Internal Audit, and other internal investigative bodies, as necessary.
* Interpret and apply corporate policies and practices, employment law, and other regulations to provide advice, guidance, or clarification for ER inquiries.
* Facilitate and apply interventions to resolve low\-risk employee disagreements, conflicts, or misunderstandings when needed.
* Compile investigation findings into concise investigation reports and clearly communicate conclusions and recommendations to relevant stakeholders to drive for decisions.
* Deliver warnings and disciplinary actions when required.
* Maintain required documentation including intake and investigative notes, supporting documents, and final reports.
* Collaborate and partner with HRBPs, internal Employment Legal, HR partners, and Employee Success Shared Services organizations to review and implement workforce change or reduction strategy plans, ensuring ER risks checks are thoroughly reviewed.
* Provide expertise and case management of ER issues, including Performance Management, from initial intake to resolution, received from managers, HR Business Partners (HRBPs) and other employees, for assigned business(es).
* Deliver expertise, consultation, guidance and coaching to managers and HRBPs to address employee behavior and performance concerns; provide guidance and assist with the development and delivery of appropriate feedback or corrective/disciplinary actions which align with company approach, practices, and processes.
* Track, report, and analyze case trends utilizing Salesforce’s technology\-based case management system.
* Continuously use AI tools at work to improve workflows, streamline case documentation, and optimize data analysis.
* Assist with the creation and implementation of further ER and HR related policies and templates.
* Collaborate closely with HR stakeholders to ensure consistency and compliance with applicable laws, regulations and Company policies.
* Create and deliver presentations to management on ER topics, trends and learnings.
* ER support for other locations for adequate APAC coverage.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Must have demonstrated ability to conduct thorough ER investigations based on data; ability to document and report cases in a detailed manner and to arrive at logical and fact based recommendations.
* Minimum 7\+ years of HR experience (can include broad HR Generalist knowledge) with 2\-3 years Employee Relations experience or equivalent role that included dedicated ER work.
* Business level English language ability including reading, writing, listening and speaking.
* Prior HR experience supporting locations in India.
* Understanding of key principles of performance management and demonstrated ability in guiding and coaching managers through a range of ER issues.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to handle escalations
* Demonstrated ability to navigate successfully within ambiguity, multiple priorities, and a constantly changing environment.
* Ability to operate/advise in the "gray" areas. Adept understanding of client motivations and business pain points; effective at leveraging inputs to influence solid business decisions.
* Comfortable dealing with conflict resolution.
* Ability to make decisions guided by policies, practices, procedures and business plans; receives general oversight and direction from Senior Director ER.
* Demonstrated proficiency in using AI tools, with a commitment to continuously leverage AI to enhance everyday work and operational efficiency.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in working in a centralised ER or HR model.
* Experience working in a high volume, fast\-paced environment, preferably in a high growth technology company.
* Experience with systems including Workday, HR Acuity, Slack and Google
* Creates and executes influence strategies that persuade key stakeholders to take action that will advance shared interest and business goals.
* Experience providing coaching and guidance to other HR members and Managers.
* Uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external business issues to improve delivery of services.
* Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective using existing solutions.
