title: Junior Support Consultant - Major Incident Management
description:
**About EG**
 At EG, we build software that makes a difference.
   

  

 Our industry\-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.
   

  

 Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security. We are a thriving global workforce of 3000\+ employees, with a 900\+ strong team based in Mangaluru, India.
   

  

 If you are ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you will thrive here. You will be trusted to grow your skills, shape meaningful solutions, and make an impact together with talented colleagues across borders.
   

  

**As Part Of The Department**
 We are looking for
 **Junior Support Consultant** 
 for our Major Incident Management teambetween
 **1 to 2 years** 
 of experience to be based at our
 **Mangalore** 
 office in India. The team are co\-working with colleagues in Norway, Sweden and Poland.
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 Work From Home (Remote)/Work from Office (Hybrid)
   

  

**Work Hours:** 
 24/7 shift solution on rotation
   

  

 The role sits within the Support organisation for Retail \& Supply Chain. Outside of running major incidents, the person works as part of the 2nd line support team, handling technical cases, tickets and tasks. Day\-to\-day direction including support priorities and workload comes from the 2nd Line Support Manager for Retail \& Supply Chain, and on the major incident process the role works to the Team Manager – Major Incident.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Verify, assess, and declare Major Incidents based on business impact and severity, acting as the designated authority for Major Incident declaration.
* Respond immediately to potential Major Incidents reported by internal teams, customers, monitoring tools, or external stakeholders.
* Create, manage, and maintain the Major Incident ticket within the support system, ensuring all incident\-related activities and communications are accurately documented.
* Serve as the central point of communication, providing regular updates to internal stakeholders, business unit management, customers, and relevant account or leadership teams throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Conduct Post\-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and prepare Major Incident Reports, including incident details, timeline of events, resolution, preventive measures, and improvement actions.
* Handle Level 2 technical support incidents, service requests, and operational tasks, ensuring resolution within agreed service levels.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve escalated incidents and service requests, providing effective technical support and guidance.
* Contribute technical expertise to the support organization and maintain accurate, up\-to\-date knowledge base articles and documentation.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Minimum 1–2 years of hands\-on experience managing Major Incidents, Critical Incidents, or high\-severity production issues in a complex IT environment.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification (incident management); further ITIL modules an advantage
* Experience in service desk, support or incident management, ideally in a software / SaaS environment.
* Experience working in a 24x7 support environment and participating in on\-call or incident management rotations is preferred.
* Exposure to collaborative incident resolution and swarming or equivalent cross\-functional working.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks, particularly ITIL Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, and Change Management processes.
* Experience working with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC Remedy, or similar ticketing systems.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience engaging customers, business leaders, and technical teams.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Calm, decisive and well organized under pressure.
* Clear, structured communicator with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Able to coordinate cross\-functional specialists at speed.
* Analytical, with a root\-cause and improvement mindset.
* Good judgement on when to escalate and when to involve management or the Security Officer.


**Our Values**
* Lead the Industry \- We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry
* Make it Happen \- We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact
* Stronger Together \- We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.


 Curious what it's really like to work at EG!
   

  

 Explore the life at EG, our values and meet some of your feature colleagues, working at EG
   

  

 Learn more about EG  here .

title: Application Support Engineer
description:
The Wealth Data \& Analytics (DnA) Production Management team operates a unified platform, providing essential data for wealth management services to Ultra High Net Worth clients globally, including Citi Private Bank, Citi Gold, and Wealth at Work. This scalable, regulatory\-compliant, and global platform processes millions of daily transactions, enabling real\-time financial decisions, data integrity, and critical business operations. The successful candidate will support and stabilize this foundational data infrastructure, crucial for delivering world\-class private banking services.
   

  

 The Apps Support Intmd Analyst is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in\-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Good understanding of how the team and area integrate with others in accomplishing the objectives of the subfunction/ job family. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* The Apps Support Intmd Analyst provides technical and business support for users of Citi Applcations.
* Utilizes good understanding of apps support procedures and concepts and basic knowledge of other technical areas to field issues and queries from stakeholders, provide short\-term resolutions and work with relevant technology partners for long term remediation.
* Develop a comprehensive understanding of how areas of apps support collectively integrate to contribute to achieving business goals.

* Participates in disaster recovery testing

* Microsoft Strong knowledge of Microsoft based operating systems

* Other Applications Knowledge / working experience of ITRS Active Console/other monitoring tools
* Knowledge / working experience of Autosys/scheduler.


**Additional Skills (preferable)**

* Participation in some process improvements.
* Previous experience or interest in standardization of procedures and practices.

* Evaluates (sometimes complex) situations using multiple sources of information Developed communication and diplomacy skills to persuade and influence

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Build the Future of Generative AI with goML** 




 At goML, we’re building the next generation of Machine Learning platforms and Generative AI services that solve real\-world enterprise problems. We work at the intersection of cutting\-edge research and production\-grade engineering—turning ideas into scalable, impactful AI systems.
 



 We’re looking for a AI / Machine Learning Engineer to join our core team of young hustlers. In this role, you’ll design, build, and productionize GenAI systems—from model training and fine\-tuning to deployment and monitoring. If you’re excited about shaping how AI is built, scaled, and delivered, this is the place for you.
 



  





**Why You? Why Now?** 




 Generative AI is moving fast—from experimentation to enterprise adoption. We need engineers who can bridge research and production, build reliable ML pipelines, and turn GenAI breakthroughs into real business outcomes. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys ownership, experimentation, and solving complex problems end to end.
 



  





**What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)** 




  





 First 30 Days: Foundation \& Immersion
 


* Understand goML’s ML and GenAI platforms, use cases, and architecture
* Get familiar with existing training, inference, and deployment pipelines
* Study current approaches to RAG, LLM fine\-tuning, and model evaluation
* Collaborate with senior engineers and product teams to understand business problems



  





 First 60 Days: Build \& Experiment
 


* Design and develop Generative AI solutions using techniques like RAG, transformers, and LLM\-based architectures
* Fine\-tune pre\-trained LLMs for domain\-specific and task\-specific use cases
* Build and maintain data pipelines for training and inference workflows
* Apply strong software engineering practices to ML and GenAI pipelines
* Evaluate, analyze, and benchmark model performance and quality
* Develop and deploy proof\-of\-concept GenAI systems



  





 First 180 Days: Ownership \& Scale
 


* Own end\-to\-end ML/GenAI pipelines—from training to production deployment
* Implement model optimization and compression techniques where applicable
* Productionize ML and GenAI research for real\-world enterprise use cases
* Monitor deployed models and continuously improve performance and reliability
* Stay current with advancements in Generative AI and apply them thoughtfully
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to solve challenging business problems at scale



  





**What You Bring (Qualifications \& Skills)** 




 Must\-Have
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field
* 3\+ years of experience in Generative AI, Machine Learning, or related domains
* Strong programming skills in Python
* Hands\-on experience with RAG and LLM\-based architectures
* Experience building data pipelines, deploying ML/GenAI models, and maintaining them in production
* Solid understanding of ML/GenAI evaluation techniques
* Proficiency with Git, Docker, and Linux\-based systems
* Experience working with cloud platforms, especially AWS ML/GenAI services



  





 Nice\-to\-Have
 


* Exposure to model compression and optimization techniques
* Experience with popular ML/GenAI frameworks and tools
* Familiarity with MLOps practices and monitoring systems
* Experience working in fast\-paced startup environments



  





 Who You Are
 


* A strong problem\-solver with a research\-driven yet pragmatic mindset
* Comfortable working independently and collaboratively
* Methodical, detail\-oriented, and thoughtful in planning and execution
* A clear communicator who can explain complex ideas simply



  





 Why Work With Us?
 


* Be part of a core team building next\-gen ML \& GenAI platforms
* Work on real enterprise problems, not just experiments
* High ownership, rapid learning, and strong growth opportunities
* Remote\-first, with opportunities for in\-person collaboration
* A culture built around curiosity, hustle, and impact

 be fluent in the core libraries, tools, and cloud services listed below, and able to own end\-to\-end model development—from research and fine\-tuning through deployment, monitoring, and iteration. In this role, you’ll tackle domain\-specific challenges like LLM hallucinations, vector search scalability, real\-time inference constraints, and concept drift in vision models.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Generative AI \& LLM Engineering**
* Fine\-tune and evaluate LLMs (Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LLaMA) for specialized tasks
* Deploy high\-throughput inference pipelines using vLLM or Triton Inference Server
* Design agent\-based workflows with LangChain or LangGraph, integrating vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate) for retrieval\-augmented generation
* Build scalable inference APIs with FastAPI or Flask, managing batching, concurrency, and rate\-limiting


**Computer Vision Development**
* Develop and optimize CV models (YOLOv8, Mask R\-CNN, ResNet, EfficientNet, ByteTrack) for detection, segmentation, classification, and tracking
* Implement real\-time pipelines using NVIDIA DeepStream or OpenCV (cv2\); optimize with TensorRT or ONNX Runtime for edge and cloud deployments
* Handle data challenges—augmentation, domain adaptation, semi\-supervised learning—and mitigate model drift in production


**MLOps \& Deployment**
* Containerize models and services with Docker; orchestrate with Kubernetes (KServe) or AWS SageMaker Pipelines
* Implement CI/CD for model/version management (MLflow, DVC), automated testing, and performance monitoring (Prometheus \+ Grafana)
* Manage scalability and cost by leveraging cloud autoscaling on AWS (EC2/EKS), GCP (Vertex AI), or Azure ML (AKS)


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Define SLAs for latency, accuracy, and throughput alongside product and DevOps teams
* Evangelize best practices in prompt engineering, model governance, data privacy, and interpretability
* Mentor junior engineers on reproducible research, code reviews, and end\-to\-end AI delivery


**Required Qualifications**
 You
 **must** 
 be proficient in at least one tool from each category below:
   

  

* LLM Frameworks \& Tooling:


 Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, vLLM, or LLaMA
   

  

* Agent \& Retrieval Tools:


 LangChain or LangGraph; RAG with Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus
   

  

* Inference Serving:


 Triton Inference Server; FastAPI or Flask
   

  

* Computer Vision Frameworks \& Libraries:


 PyTorch or TensorFlow; OpenCV (cv2\) or NVIDIA DeepStream
   

  

* Model Optimization:


 TensorRT; ONNX Runtime; Torch\-TensorRT
   

  

* MLOps \& Versioning:


 Docker and Kubernetes (KServe, SageMaker); MLflow or DVC
   

  

* Monitoring \& Observability:


 Prometheus; Grafana
   

  

* Cloud Platforms:


 AWS (SageMaker, EC2/EKS)
 **or** 
 GCP (Vertex AI, AI Platform)
 **or** 
 Azure ML (AKS, ML Studio)
   

  

* Programming Languages:


 Python (required); C\+\+ or Go (preferred)
   

  

**Additionally**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or a related field
* 3–5 years of professional experience shipping both generative and vision\-based AI models in production
* Strong problem\-solving mindset; ability to debug issues like LLM drift, vector index staleness, and model degradation
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills


**Typical Domain Challenges You’ll Solve**
* LLM Hallucination \& Safety: Implement grounding, filtering, and classifier layers to reduce false or unsafe outputs
* Vector DB Scaling: Maintain low\-latency, high\-throughput similarity search as embeddings grow to millions

title: Python Backend Developer – FastAPI, MongoDB, AI/Media Pipelines
description:
Intellemo.ai is building next\-gen agentic video generation platform.
 



 We are now hiring a hands\-on Python Backend Developer to work on the core backend systems behind our AI marketing and video products.
   




 About the Role
 
 This is not a role for someone who only wants to write fresh code from scratch.
 



 We need someone who can read an existing backend codebase, understand how things work, debug issues, and make practical engineering decisions.
 



 In the age of AI coding tools, writing code is becoming easier. Reading code, understanding tradeoffs, and deciding what should actually change is becoming more valuable.
 



 You will work directly with the founder on backend systems involving FastAPI, MongoDB, GCP, API integrations, AI workflows, and media processing pipelines.
   




 What You Will Work On
 * Build and maintain backend services using Python and FastAPI
* Work with MongoDB data models, queries, and backend logic
* Build and consume REST APIs
* Integrate with external platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other marketing APIs
* Connect with AI/ML APIs for automation and agentic workflows
* Work on internal AI workflow systems for marketing automation
* Build and improve media processing pipelines for image and video generation
* Work with tools such as FFmpeg, ImageMagick, Wand, or similar libraries
* Debug production issues across APIs, background jobs, and data flows
* Improve existing backend architecture without unnecessary rewrites
* Collaborate with frontend/product teams to ship reliable features
* Use AI coding tools responsibly to speed up development, while still reviewing and understanding the code



  




 Core Skills Required
 * Strong Python fundamentals
* Hands\-on experience with FastAPI
* Experience working with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases
* Ability to build and debug REST APIs
* Ability to read and understand an existing codebase
* Good understanding of backend architecture and data flow
* Comfort with async workflows, background jobs, or long\-running processes
* Ability to write clean, maintainable code
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to make practical tradeoffs instead of overengineering



  




 Good to Have
 * Experience with GCP
* Experience with media pipelines, video processing, audio processing, or image rendering
* Experience with FFmpeg, ImageMagick, Wand, OpenCV, or similar tools
* Experience integrating with marketing APIs such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Pinterest
* Familiarity with GraphQL or API gateways
* Familiarity with LangChain, CrewAI, LangGraph, MCP, or similar AI/agentic frameworks
* Experience with web scraping or data extraction using BeautifulSoup, Playwright, or similar tools
* Experience using Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or other AI coding tools responsibly


 What We Care About Most
 
 We care less about the exact number of years on your resume and more about whether you can think clearly through backend problems.
 



 A strong candidate should be able to:
 


* Open an unfamiliar codebase and understand it
* Identify what is fragile, slow, or hard to maintain
* Decide whether something needs a quick fix or deeper refactor
* Debug issues without randomly changing code
* Use AI\-generated code carefully instead of trusting it blindly
* Explain technical decisions clearly
* Ship practical improvements without breaking production


 Not a Good Fit If
 * You only want to work on new code from scratch
* You cannot read and reason through existing code
* You depend on AI tools to write code you do not understand
* You prefer theory over shipping
* You want a narrow backend role with no product context
* You are uncomfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment


 Experience
 
 1\-3 years of backend development experience preferred.
 



 Strong candidates with less formal experience but strong demonstrated backend work are welcome.
 



 A computer science degree is not mandatory. Real backend ability matters more.
   




 What We Offer
 * Direct work with the founder on core backend and product systems
* High ownership from day one
* Exposure to AI, marketing automation, and media generation workflows
* Opportunity to work on real production systems, not toy projects
* Fast learning curve across backend, AI workflows, APIs, and media pipelines
* Competitive salary in the range of ₹6\-8 LPA
* ESOP option post probation, based on performance and fit


 Location
 
 Gurgaon, Haryana.
 



  





 This is a full\-time, in\-office role.
 


* We are not hiring for remote or work\-from\-home for this position. The role requires close collaboration, faster iteration, and direct product\-building with the core team.

title: Analyst - API Business
description:
****The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance****
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear \- to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
   

  

 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
   

  

 We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.
   

  

 If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This isn’t a typical API Analyst role.
   

  

 You will be at the intersection of trading infrastructure, client experience, and technical execution — enabling traders to seamlessly integrate and operate on CoinDCX’s APIs.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with senior team members, Product, Tech, and CX teams to onboard and support API users including retail algo traders and emerging HNI clients.
   

  

 You will play a critical role in ensuring reliability, speed, and accuracy in how clients interact with our trading systems, directly impacting trading experience and platform trust.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Support clients in integrating with CoinDCX Spot and Futures APIs, including API key setup, authentication, and order testing
* Troubleshoot API\-related issues such as failed orders, data mismatches, and connectivity errors using structured playbooks
* Act as the first line of support for API users, ensuring timely responses and clear resolution paths
* Coordinate cross\-functionally with Tech, Product, CX, and Business teams to resolve issues efficiently
* Track, log, and manage issues through internal tools, ensuring proper documentation and escalation hygiene
* Monitor SLA metrics such as response time (FRT) and resolution turnaround time (TAT), and contribute to weekly reporting
* Improve API documentation, FAQs, and internal knowledge bases to reduce repeat queries and enhance client self\-serve

* Have 1\-2 years of experience

* Are familiar with tools like Postman or similar API testing platforms
* Have basic knowledge of a scripting language (Python preferred) and are comfortable reading or testing API flows
* Understand (or are eager to learn) financial markets, crypto trading, and core trading concepts like order types and execution flows
* Bring strong attention to detail in issue tracking, logging, and documentation
* Communicate clearly and effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Are highly structured and able to follow defined processes while maintaining speed and accuracy
* Take ownership of problems and see them through to resolution, escalating only when necessary
* Thrive in cross\-functional environments and collaborate effectively with Tech, Product, CX, and Business teams


**You’ll Know You’re Winning When**

* API\-related queries are resolved efficiently with minimal escalations
* Issue logging and documentation are accurate, structured, and actionable
* Repeat queries reduce due to improved documentation and proactive guidance
* Client feedback reflects strong satisfaction with API support quality

 This role sits at the core of CoinDCX’s trading infrastructure experience, directly impacting how clients interact with our APIs and execute trades at scale.
   

  

 You will gain hands\-on exposure to real\-world trading systems, APIs, and high\-frequency environments while working closely with Product and Engineering teams.
   

  

 It’s a strong foundation role for anyone looking to build a career in crypto, trading systems, or technical product and operations.

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your technical understanding and problem\-solving approach
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A real\-world API troubleshooting or integration scenario
* Culture \& Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For select candidates


**Where We Work**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
   

  

 With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organisation. This role is based out of our
 **Bengaluru office** 
 , where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources

 ﻿﻿
   

  

**Ready to Build What’s Next?**

 Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: ROS Engineer I
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Development**
* Develop and maintain ROS 2 nodes in Python and/or C\+\+ for sensing, control, telemetry, and mission execution, under the technical direction of the reporting lead.
* Define, implement, and version message, service, and action interfaces between subsystems, keeping contracts stable as the platform evolves.
* Write launch files, parameter sets, and configuration profiles that allow the same codebase to run across different vehicle variants without code changes.


**Hardware \& Sensor Integration**
* Bring up and integrate payloads IMU, depth/pressure sensors, DVL, altimeters, imaging and scanning sonar, cameras: including driver integration, timestamping, TF frame alignment, and calibration data capture.
* Interface thrusters, motor controllers, and auxiliary actuators over serial, CAN, and Ethernet, implementing watchdogs and safe\-state behaviour on loss of command.
* Configure DDS settings and QoS profiles for the topside–vehicle link, managing bandwidth constraints and ensuring graceful degradation when the link is degraded or drops.


**Testing \& Validation**
* Build and maintain simulation environments (Gazebo, RViz) and hardware\-in\-the\-loop setups so that failure modes are found before wet testing.
* Deploy and test software on embedded and edge compute platforms (NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi), including containerised builds, dependency management, and boot\-time service configuration.
* Instrument systems with rosbag2 logging, diagnostics topics, and health monitoring; analyse recorded data post\-mission to identify root causes rather than symptoms.
* Reproduce field\-reported issues in a controlled environment, isolate them to software, hardware, or configuration, and drive fixes through to verified closure.


**Field Operations**
* Participate in tank, harbour, and open\-water trials: pre\-dive checks, on\-site debugging, data capture, and post\-trial reporting and feed observed behaviour back into the development cycle.


**Documentation \& Collaboration**
* Document nodes, interfaces, parameters, and system configurations to a standard that allows another engineer to deploy and troubleshoot without the author present.
* Work alongside embedded, mechanical, controls, and product teams during system\-level integration, and follow the team's Git branching, code review, and release practices.

* Education: B.E/B.Tech in Robotics, Electronics, Computer Science, Electrical, or related fields.
* Experience: 0–2 years in robotics or ROS development (academic projects or internships count).
* Certifications (Preferred): ROS 2 Development, Python/C\+\+ Programming, Embedded Linux.

title: ASIC Verification Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Hardware and Software Developer. The role is multifaceted \- SoCV testbench Infrastructure, Bare\-metal boot, Silicon Bringup Tools and CPU/SOC/GPU test frameworks. It involves a detailed understanding of the nVidia CPU, GPU, SOC system and boot architectures. The tools and technologies are complex and involve code that coordinates many IPs in the overall SOC. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is our development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of delivering new technology to the market. We are looking for a creative and hardworking engineer who is passionate about joining a dynamic \& agile SoCV/Emulation Infrastructure and test\-frameworks team.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* The work includes building tools, infrastructure, and test frameworks used in RTL\-simulations, c\-simulations, Emulation, FPGA, and on Silicon.
* You will understand Tegra system architecture, with a focus on all IPs in the SOC that are involved in boot and security features.
* The tools that you build give Design and Verification teams the ability to access registers/memory/DMA engines and other features in their unit. The tools also enable test re\-use across multiple platforms (RTL, models, Emulation, and Silicon). The gamut of tools is wide and you also develop features used for Silicon bring up (example: FUSE, ATE, Security, Flash/DMA, Board I2Cs, USB debug devices among others). We strive for the highest quality of test frameworks and tools that we deliver from this team.
* You would assess and build C\-model or RTL\-simulation capability that allows us to simulate the features before Silicon arrival in a pre\-silicon environment.


**What We Need To See**
* BS or MS in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience with 0\-2 years of experience
* Strong programmer who is proficient with C, C\+\+, Python.
* Understanding of SOC and System Architecture.
* Understanding of How the SOC Devices like DMA, interrupt\-engines, CPU, boot\-devices, MMU/IOMMU function.
* Operating System and Device\-Driver concepts and ability to write no\-OS test frameworks \- i.e tests that run directly on the bare\-metal SOC.
* A good programmer takes pride in building scalable and maintainable software.
* Understanding Hardware and/or Software development life cycle.


**Way To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Previous experience handling Silicon Bringup and in enabling Emulation/FPGA related test frameworks.
* Exposure to Testbench architectures (C\+\+ testbenches, SV/UVM based testbenches).
* Verilog and System Verilog coding skills are a plus.


 With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our elite engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  Ingersoll Rand is a global provider of mission\-critical flow creation, life science and industrial solutions. Ingersoll Rand Engineering \& Technology Center (IRETC) in Bangalore, driven by an ownership mindset and entrepreneurial spirit, has been a beacon of innovation for over 20 years, embodying our purpose to "Make Life Better" for our employees, customers, shareholders and the planet.

**Job Summary**
 This role for Engineer to assist routine embedded software development and design responsibilities of the Engineering \& Technology Center to support our controls and software team.
   

  

 The selected candidates will undergo comprehensive training covering embedded C/C\+\+ programming, device drivers, Linux OS basics, hardware schematics, and design fundamentals — for a duration of minimum 3 months at the Engineering \& Technology Center, Bangalore. Upon successful completion of the training program and assessment, individuals will be assigned to support specific product development projects within the embedded systems team. * Develop flowcharts, layouts, and technical documentation to identify requirements and design solutions.

* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and software process improvement activities.
* Develop and apply device drivers and work with Linux OS and embedded C toolchains.
* Use Python scripting for build automation, testing support, and tooling development.
* Leverage AI tools (AI coding assistants, AI\-assisted code review, AI\-powered documentation) to improve productivity.
* Interface with cross\-functional and global teams to understand requirements and review designs.
* Provide post\-production support and troubleshooting.


**Competencies**
* Strong understanding of C/C\+\+ and embedded programming fundamentals

* Experience with device drivers, Linux OS, and embedded C toolchains
* Knowledge of hardware schematics and PCB design basics
* Ability to use debugging tools such as CRO, multimeters, and logic analyzers
* Strong software design and engineering discipline
* Excellent communication skills and team collaboration
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and adaptable to changing requirements

* Familiarity with AI tools and prompt engineering for coding support


**Qualifications**

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Embedded Software Engineer** 




**Department:** 
 R\&D – Women’s Health \& Fertility Solutions
 



**Location:** 
 Vapi, Gujarat
 



**Reports To:** 
 Manager / Senior Manager – R\&D.
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




 To design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware and user interface software for medical devices, ensuring precise environmental control, safety, reliability, usability, and compliance with global medical device software standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities: –** 




**1\. Embedded Firmware Development** 




 • Develop and maintain embedded firmware on ARM Cortex\-M microcontrollers (STM32 / NXP / TI).
 



 • Design modular, scalable, and maintainable firmware architecture.
 



 • Implement real\-time tasks, state machines, interrupts, and timers.
 



 • Support hardware bring\-up, low\-level drivers, and peripheral configuration.
 



  





**2\. Control Algorithms \& Environmental Regulation** 




 • Design and implement PID control algorithms for temperature, CO₂, O₂, and humidity regulation.
 



 • Tune control loops for stability, accuracy, and fast settling time.
 



 • Implement closed\-loop control for heaters, solenoid valves, fans, and motors.
 



 • Support performance validation under varying environmental and load conditions.
 



  





**3\. Sensor Interfacing \& Data Acquisition** 




 • Interface with sensors including RTD, NDIR CO₂, O₂, and RH sensors.
 



 • Implement ADC, I²C, SPI, and UART communication drivers.
 



 • Handle sensor calibration, compensation, filtering, and fault detection.
 



 • Ensure reliable and accurate data acquisition for clinical use.
 



  





**4\. Actuator Control \& Safety Functions** 




 • Control power devices such as heaters, solenoid valves, fans, relays, and motors.
 



 • Implement alarms, safety interlocks, watchdogs, and fault\-handling mechanisms.
 



 • Define and manage safe states and recovery logic during abnormal conditions.
 



 • Ensure software behaviour aligns with patient safety and risk mitigation requirements.
 



  





**5\. HMI \& Communication Interfaces** 




 • Develop communication interfaces between embedded systems and HMI/UI.
 



 • Implement protocols such as RS\-485, CAN, and Ethernet.
 



 • Support UI data exchange, command handling, alarms, and status indications.
 



 • Collaborate with UI/UX and application software teams to ensure usability and responsiveness.
 



  





**6\. Data Logging, Calibration \& Diagnostics** 




 • Implement data logging for operational parameters, alarms, and events.
 



 • Develop calibration routines for sensors and control systems.
 



 • Support diagnostic modes, service tools, and traceability of device performance.
 



 • Ensure data integrity and availability for validation and field support.
 



  





**7\. Testing, Debugging \& Validation Support** 




 • Perform unit testing, integration testing, and debugging of embedded software.
 



 • Support software verification and validation activities.
 



 • Participate in system\-level testing and clinical simulation scenarios.
 



 • Support production testing and field troubleshooting activities.
 



  





**8\. Documentation \& Regulatory Compliance** 




 • Prepare and maintain software documentation as per IEC 62304 requirements.
 



 • Support software lifecycle documentation aligned with ISO 13485\.
 



 • Contribute to software risk management, traceability matrices, and change control.
 



 • Support internal and external audits and regulatory submissions.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 




 • B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, or related field.
 



 • 5–8 years of experience in embedded software development.
 



 • Experience in medical devices, diagnostics, fertility systems, or other regulated products preferred.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience with ARM Cortex\-M platforms and real\-time embedded systems.
 



  





**Skills and Competencies:** 




 • Strong proficiency in Embedded C / C\+\+.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with STM32 / NXP / TI microcontrollers.
 



 • Solid understanding of control systems and PID tuning.
 



 • Experience with sensor interfacing and industrial communication protocols.
 



 • Knowledge of medical device software standards (IEC 62304\) and quality systems.
 



 • Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
 



 • Ability to work effectively in a regulated, cross\-functional environment.

**About CynLr** 




 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. (a demo video link).
 



 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to assemble a Smartphone or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots
 *intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly,* 
 eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into
 *modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories* 
 that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are
 *deeply inspired by neuroscience,* 
 modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.

 .

 **product capability and customer reality**

title: Product Lead
description:
**Product Lead** 




**﻿
 
 Job Description** 



 About the Role
 
 We are building a Context Engine that enables Agentic AI systems and LLMs to reason with reliable, structured and domain\-specific context.
 



 The Context Engine uses Ontology, Knowledge Graphs and semantic relationships to represent domain knowledge and provide AI systems with the right context at the right time.
 



 We are looking for a Product Lead who can work at the intersection of Product, Ontology/KG, AI, Engineering and Customer POCs.
 



 This is not a conventional project\-management role. You will be expected to understand the technology at a conceptual and working level, reason with engineering teams, conduct research, contribute to ontology/KG development, test ideas, document the technology, interact with users and help shape the MVP roadmap.
 



 You will work closely with the CPO, founders/ideators and engineering teams to take the Context Engine from concept → MVP → validated POCs → production handover.
 


 What You Will Do1\. Own Day\-to\-Day MVP Product Execution
 
 ·      Translate the Context Engine vision into clear MVP capabilities, use cases and build priorities.
 



 ·      Work closely with the CPO and founders to convert ideas and hypotheses into an actionable roadmap.
 



 ·      Track MVP progress, dependencies, risks and decisions.
 



 ·      Identify gaps, ambiguity and blockers and drive them toward resolution.
 



 ·      Ensure that the MVP remains focused on its intended customer and business outcomes.
 



 ·      Participate actively in product and technical discussions rather than simply tracking tasks.
 


 2\. Work Closely with Ontology \& Knowledge Graph Teams
 
 ·      Understand and contribute to the design of domain ontologies and Knowledge Graphs.
 



 ·      Help identify entities, classes, properties and relationships required to represent domain knowledge.
 



 ·      Review and refine semantic relationships and terminology.
 



 ·      Contribute to manual triple definition and semantic modelling.
 



 ·      Ensure that relationships accurately represent the intended meaning and domain behaviour.
 



 ·      Maintain consistency in terminology and ontology definitions.
 



 ·      Work with engineers to translate domain concepts into machine\-readable representations.
 


 3\. Research \& Technical Reasoning
 
 ·      Research emerging approaches in Ontology, Knowledge Graphs, RDF / semantic technologies, LLM grounding, RAG, Agentic AI, Context Engineering and Knowledge Representation.
 



 ·      Compare alternative technical approaches and communicate their implications to the team.
 



 ·      Form hypotheses and help design experiments to validate them.
 



 ·      Analyze test results and convert learnings into product or technical improvements.
 



 ·      Challenge assumptions constructively when evidence suggests a different approach.
 


 4\. Facilitate Between Engineering Teams
 
 ·      Act as the connective layer between the teams involved in building the Context Engine.
 



 ·      Work with Ontology/KG engineers, backend/application engineers, AI/LLM engineers, LinkEye engineering/product teams, testing/QA teams and production/DevOps teams.
 



 ·      Facilitate understanding and decisions rather than simply passing requirements between teams.
 



 ·      Ask and drive clarity around the problem, assumptions, evidence, customer need, technical implications and MVP priority.
 


 5\. Customer Engagement \& POCs
 
 ·      Participate in customer discovery and technical discussions.
 



 ·      Understand customer problems and identify the context required to solve them.
 



 ·      Support and drive Context Engine POCs.
 



 ·      Define POC scenarios, test cases and expected outcomes.
 



 ·      Work with users to understand failures, gaps and unexpected behaviour.
 



 ·      Translate customer feedback into actionable insights for the build team.
 



 ·      Identify patterns across POCs that can influence the product roadmap.
 


 6\. Product \& Technical Documentation
 
 ·      Own and maintain documentation required to build, explain and evolve the Context Engine.
 



 ·      Product documentation: product vision, problem statement, use cases, MVP scope, capabilities, roadmap, POC scenarios, success criteria and limitations.
 



 ·      Technical documentation: architecture, data/context flows, ontology/KG concepts, semantic relationships, integration points, technical decisions, experiments, test methodology and known limitations.
 



 ·      Ontology documentation: entity/class definitions, property definitions, relationship definitions, semantic rules, examples and modelling guidelines.
 



 ·      Explain technically complex concepts clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
 


 7\. Product Articulation \& Marketing Support
 
 ·      Work with the CPO and marketing/content teams to articulate what the Context Engine is, why it is required for Agentic AI, what problem it solves, how it differs from conventional RAG/LLM approaches, what the MVP demonstrates and what customer use cases it addresses.
 



 ·      Convert complex technical concepts into clear, accurate and compelling product narratives without oversimplifying the technology.
 


 8\. Production Handover
 
 ·      Define MVP acceptance criteria.
 



 ·      Ensure product and technical documentation is complete.
 



 ·      Capture architectural and operational learnings.
 



 ·      Document known limitations and future requirements.
 



 ·      Work with the production team to prepare the handover.
 



 ·      Support the transition from experimental MVP to production\-ready product.
 


 What We Are Looking ForCore Requirements
 
 ·      Conceptual understanding of Ontology and Knowledge Graphs.
 



 ·      Ability to reason about semantics, entities, relationships and domain meaning.
 



 ·      Ability to conduct technical research independently.
 



 ·      Ability to translate ambiguous ideas into structured product requirements and experiments.
 



 ·      Ability to understand complex technical concepts and explain them clearly.
 



 ·      Strong analytical and reasoning ability.
 



 ·      Excellent written and spoken English.
 



 ·      Strong technical writing capability.
 



 ·      Comfortable working with engineers and technical teams.
 



 ·      Strong collaboration and mediation skills.
 



 ·      Comfortable interacting with customers/users during POCs.
 



 ·      Strong ownership mindset.
 


 Highly Preferred
 
 ·      Prior experience working with the network\-management/domain context.
 



 ·      Understanding of RDF, OWL, SPARQL or other semantic technologies.
 



 ·      Aware of Neo4j or other Knowledge Graph platforms.
 



 ·      Understanding of LLMs, RAG and Agentic AI.
 



 ·      Experience working with AI/ML or developer\-oriented products.
 


 The Kind of Person We Are Looking For
 
 You may be a good fit if you enjoy moving between different worlds:
 



 Domain knowledge ↔ Ontology ↔ Engineering ↔ Product ↔ Customer
 



 You do not have to be the deepest expert in every technology. But you should be someone who can:
 



 ·      Understand
 



 ·      Question
 



 ·      Research
 



 ·      Reason
 



 ·      Model
 



 ·      Test
 



 ·      Document
 



 ·      Communicate
 



 You should enjoy working in an environment where the product is still being discovered and where new questions are often more valuable than immediately having answers.
 



 You should be comfortable saying: "I don’t know yet. Let me research it, test the assumption and come back with evidence."
 


 What Success Looks Like
 
 ·      The Context Engine MVP has a clear and continuously evolving product definition.
 



 ·      Ontology/KG concepts are semantically consistent and well documented.
 



 ·      Engineering teams have clarity on what they are building and why.
 



 ·      Technical decisions are supported by research and experimentation.
 



 ·      MVP progress, risks and dependencies are visible.
 



 ·      Customer POCs generate meaningful product learning.
 



 ·      Product and technical documentation are maintained throughout the build.
 



 ·      The CPO and founders have a reliable partner for day\-to\-day MVP execution.
 



 ·      The validated MVP can be confidently handed over to the production team.
 


 This Role Is NOT
 
 ·      A Jira/task tracking role
 



 ·      A Scrum Master role
 



 ·      A conventional project coordinator role
 



 ·      A documentation\-only role
 



 ·      A pure ontology/KG engineering role
 



 ·      A pure Product Manager role
 



 It is a hands\-on technical product and knowledge role that combines domain understanding, semantic modelling, research, product thinking, technical communication and cross\-team collaboration.
 


 Suggested Experience
 
 1\-2 years of relevant experience preferred.
 



 Candidates with strong analytical ability, ontology/KG exposure and relevant Product domain experience may be considered even if they do not match every item above.
 


 Role Details
 
**Reporting:** 
 CPO / Product Leadership
 



**Employment Type:** 
 \[Full\-time]
 


* **Location:** 
 \[Hybrid]

 , taking them from customer discovery and problem definition through solution design, delivery, launch, adoption and post\-release evaluation.
* **Champion the customer and user** 
 , working with customers internal stakeholders, , relationship managers and customers internal stakeholders to uncover unmet needs, distinguish underlying problems from requested solutions, and translate insights into clear outcomes, requirements and acceptance criteria.
* **Shape and validate scalable solutions** 
 , collaborating with business, technology, design, data and operations teams on processes, workflows, prototypes and analytics capabilities while balancing customer value, operational impact, data needs and technology constraints.
* **Manage and prioritize assigned product backlogs** 
 , assessing opportunities against customer value, business impact, strategic alignment, effort, dependencies and risk, and ensuring work is sufficiently clear and delivery ready.
* **Partner across business, technology, data science, operations and governance** 
 to guide assigned features and workstreams through the product development lifecycle, resolve ambiguity, surface trade\-offs and communicate effectively between business and technical audiences.
* **Build alignment and adoption around the product** 
 , clearly communicating its vision, value and intended outcomes, supporting users through launch, and encouraging effective use of delivered capabilities.
* **Define and measure product success** 
 , using customer feedback, product data and operational evidence to evaluate value and adoption, inform prioritization, improve customer experience, quality, scalability, automation and self\-service, and strengthen reusable Product Management practices.



  
 



 Requirements 
 



 You may currently work in Product Management, Product Analysis, Business Analysis, digital transformation, data, operations or technology delivery and be looking to develop broader end\-to\-end product ownership. 
 



 You will be able to demonstrate: 
 


* **Relevant product\-delivery experience** 
 , contributing to or owning defined features, workstreams or improvements across digital, software, data, analytics or workflow products.
* **Strong customer and product thinking** 
 , with the ability to uncover underlying needs, challenge solution\-led requests and translate ambiguous problems into clear outcomes, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* **Working knowledge of Product Management and Agile delivery** 
 , with experience contributing to several stages of the lifecycle, such as discovery, prioritization, backlog management, iterative development, user validation, launch or outcome measurement.
* **Structured, business\-value\-led decision\-making** 
 , using customer feedback, product data and operational evidence to evaluate opportunities, recommend priorities and explain trade\-offs.
* **Effective cross\-functional stakeholder management** 
 , building trusted relationships across business and technology teams, aligning different perspectives and progressing work without relying on formal authority.
* **Ability to connect business needs with technical delivery** 
 , communicating clearly across different audiences and moving comfortably between the intended customer outcome and the supporting process, data and technology detail.
* **Strong execution discipline and a growth mindset** 
 , demonstrated through clear communication, sound organization, reliable follow\-through, constructive challenge and readiness to take increasing ownership.



  
 



 Nice\-to\-have: 
 



 It would be advantageous if you had some of the following: 
 


* **B2B enterprise products or financial services** 
 , including capital markets, corporate or institutional banking, benchmarking, or other complex data\-driven environments.
* **Using analytics to communicate insight** 
 , translate complex information into a clear story and help users make better\-informed decisions.
* **Digital transformation and workflow modernization** 
 , including operational improvement, automation, self\-service, change management and user adoption.
* **Product discovery and design practices** 
 , such as Jobs\-To\-Be\-Done, Human\-Centred Design, customer research, user\-journey mapping, wireframing or prototyping.
* **Enterprise technology and product\-delivery environments** 
 , including exposure to cloud or componentized architectures, APIs, Jira, Azure DevOps, Figma or comparable platforms, and working with geographically and culturally diverse teams.
* **Analytical and communication tools** 
 , including Excel, PowerPoint, Python , together with an interest in the practical application of AI and emerging technologies to customer and business problems.



  
 



 The Ideal Profile 
 



 This “ideal profile” is not a list of requirements – they are above – but is meant to give some color to the kind of person we’re looking for. If you don’t fit this profile but meet the requirements we are still keen to hear from you.  
 



  
 



 What We Can Offer 
 


* Permanent, full\-time opportunity with long\-term career stability
* A competitive compensation package that recognizes your talent
* A flexible hybrid work model, balancing office collaboration with work\-from\-home convenience
* 30 days’ annual leave (plus public holidays) and comprehensive Group Mediclaim, Group Term Life and Group Personal Accident insurance coverage for you and your loved ones
* Participation in CSR Foundation initiatives, enabling you to make a positive social impact
* Leave encashment options for added financial flexibility
* Exposure to global leaders, offering professional learning and global collaboration
* Online library membership because we believe learning should never stop
* Annual health check\-up with discounted medical rates for family members



 The Application Process 
 


- Apply with a 1\-2 page CV. If you really want this role, make sure you address the requirements within your experience. We get a lot of applications and we’re only able to contact shortlisted candidates. If you haven’t heard from us within a week, it’s likely we’ve moved forward with other applicants this time.

- An initial \~20 minute video call with someone on the product team to cover your most relevant experience.

- A product design take\-home challenge that should take you no more than one hour. This will be delivered in an interactive and collaborative 30 minute face\-to\-face or video session with someone in the technology or product team. We’ll let you know whether you’re progressing to the next round within 2 weeks.

- A final 30 minute hybrid panel interview with a small group of your potential peers. We’ll let you know if you’re successful within 10 days. Step 3 and/or step 4 will be in\-person.

description:
**Position Objective**
 The Product Manager is responsible for defining the strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for AI\-powered products built and maintained by the Technology team. This role partners closely with business Product Owners, data scientists, and engineering teams to translate organizational goals into well\-structured requirements and delivery plans. The Product Manager drives alignment across stakeholders, facilitates Agile ceremonies, and ensures that AI product development remains grounded in measurable business outcomes and user needs. This role requires a blend of product strategy, AI literacy, and Agile expertise to drive continuous value delivery in a rapidly evolving technology landscape.
   

  

**Critical Duties**
* Define and champion the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for AI\-powered products, aligning development priorities to enterprise goals and measurable business outcomes.
* Partner with business Product Owners to shape and refine the product backlog, ensuring items are clearly defined, properly prioritized, and sprint\-ready.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, business Product Owners, and the development team, translating requirements into actionable backlog items in Jira.
* Lead and facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint review, and retrospectives in partnership with the Scrum Master and business Product Owners.
* Drive prioritization decisions that balance urgency, business value, technical feasibility, and AI model performance considerations across the product portfolio.
* Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and architects to ensure AI model behavior and outputs align with product requirements and business KPIs.
* Define success metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for AI products, and track delivery against those measures on an ongoing basis.
* Engage stakeholders at all levels to gather, validate, and communicate product requirements, roadmap status, and delivery progress.
* Evaluate and accept or reject sprint deliverables in collaboration with business Product Owners based on defined acceptance criteria and Definition of Done.
* Identify and manage AI\-specific product risks — including model drift, bias, data quality gaps, and ethical considerations — as first\-class product concerns.


**Essential Duties**
**(OTHER DUTIES MAY BE ASSIGNED)**
* Maintain a well\-groomed product backlog in Jira in partnership with business Product Owners, including epics, user stories, subtasks, and bug reports with sufficient detail for development execution.
* Develop and manage product roadmaps that reflect business priorities, stakeholder input, AI model capabilities, and technical constraints.
* Collaborate with UX designers and business analysts to ensure user stories reflect validated user needs, personas, and workflows.
* Contribute to test strategy by reviewing acceptance criteria and participating in user acceptance testing (UAT) alongside business Product Owners.
* Monitor and report on sprint velocity, backlog health, and product delivery metrics to IT leadership and the Project Management Office (PMO).
* Support release planning and coordinate cross\-team dependencies with business Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and the PMO.
* Evaluate emerging AI tools, frameworks, and industry best practices to inform product decisions and roadmap strategy.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Company's Collaboration Framework and Agile practice maturity.
* Define non\-functional requirements related to AI products, including performance, reliability, security, compliance, and responsible AI standards.
* Manage and synthesize feedback from end users, business Product Owners, and development teams to continuously refine the product.
* Create appropriate product artifacts including product descriptions, feature definitions, and user requirements in standard toolsets.
* Support vendor evaluation and SOW review for AI\-related tools or platforms as needed.

**Education/Experience**

* 3\+ years of experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role in a technology environment.
* Demonstrated experience working with Agile/Scrum teams, writing or refining user stories, and managing product backlogs.
* Experience partnering with business stakeholders or business Product Owners to translate requirements into technical deliverables.
* Experience working with AI/ML products, data pipelines, or analytics platforms strongly preferred.
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery frameworks.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

**About FXPanda** 




 FXPanda by HQMENA is a digital platform designed to connect the global forex and financial trading ecosystem. The platform aims to bring together traders, brokers, fintech companies, financial service providers, educators, industry professionals, and partners in one digital ecosystem where users can discover, engage, connect, and access relevant products and services.
 



 We are looking for a
 **Product Manager** 
 who will take ownership of FXPanda’s product strategy, development, and growth. The ideal candidate should understand digital products and have experience in fintech, forex, trading, marketplaces, communities, or similar technology\-driven platforms.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Product Strategy \& Roadmap:** 
 Own FXPanda’s product vision, strategy, and roadmap. Translate business and user needs into product initiatives, prioritize features, and continuously improve the product based on market insights, data, and feedback.
 



**2\. Product Development \& Ownership:** 
 Manage the product lifecycle from ideation to launch and optimization. Prepare PRDs and product requirements, work closely with development, UI/UX, and QA teams, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality features.
 



**3\. User \& Market Research:** 
 Understand the needs, expectations, and behaviour of traders, brokers, fintech companies, financial service providers, and other target users. Conduct regular market research, competitor analysis, and benchmarking of leading forex, trading, and fintech platforms. Identify market gaps and opportunities that can help FXPanda differentiate itself and strengthen its position in the market. Stay updated on developments in forex, fintech, AI, trading technology, and digital communities.
 



**4\. Product Analytics \& Performance:** 
 Define and monitor key product KPIs, including user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and feature adoption. Analyse user behaviour and product performance to identify areas for improvement. Use data and customer feedback to support product decisions and work with Marketing and Analytics teams to develop relevant dashboards and performance reports. Conduct product experiments and A/B testing where required.
 



**5\. User Experience:** 
 Ensure FXPanda provides a simple, intuitive, and engaging user experience across web and mobile platforms. Work closely with UI/UX teams to review wireframes, prototypes, and product designs. Identify usability issues and continuously improve the user journey from registration and onboarding through engagement and conversion.
 



**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with Technology, UI/UX, Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Operations, and Management teams to ensure alignment throughout the product lifecycle. Act as the primary product point of contact and clearly communicate product requirements, priorities, timelines, and deliverables. Coordinate with external developers, technology partners, vendors, and service providers when required.
 



**7\. Product Growth \& Monetization:** 
 Identify opportunities to increase user acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue. Work with Marketing and Commercial teams to develop product\-led growth initiatives and identify suitable monetization opportunities for FXPanda, including subscriptions, premium features, lead generation, partnerships, advertising, and marketplace services. Explore opportunities to connect brokers, fintech companies, financial service providers, educators, influencers, and other industry participants through the platform.
 



**8\. Product Launch \& Continuous Improvement:** 
 Plan and coordinate product launches, beta testing, user testing, feedback collection, and product releases. Monitor product performance after launch and use user feedback, data, and market insights to prioritize future improvements. Establish a continuous improvement process to enhance the platform, user experience, and overall business performance.
 



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, Product Management, or a related field.
* **3–6 years of experience in Product Management** 
 , preferably in fintech, financial services, forex, trading, SaaS, marketplaces, communities, or digital platforms.
* Proven experience managing a digital product through its development lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of product development, Agile/Scrum, and software development processes.
* Experience preparing
 **PRDs, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria, and product roadmaps** 
 .
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Good understanding of UI/UX and digital product development.
* Ability to work effectively with developers and technical teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of product decisions.



**Preferred Experience** 




 Experience in
 **forex, CFD, trading platforms, fintech, brokerage platforms, investment applications, B2B/B2C marketplaces, online communities, financial APIs, CRM, payment systems, KYC/onboarding, mobile applications, or product analytics**

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




 Saras Analytics is looking for a Technical Project Manager to drive delivery governance across its
 



 Consulting team. This role sits at the intersection of client engagement management and technical
 



 execution — coordinating with Engagement Leads, Data Engineering pods, and cross\-functional teams
 



 to ensure every client use case is delivered on time, with full visibility into risks and blockers.
 



 The TPM will not just manage process — they will own delivery outcomes. That means understanding
 



 what the client is trying to achieve (e.g., average order value trends, sales performance dashboards),
 



 translating those into realistic project plans, and proactively flagging when timelines need adjustment
 



 before commitments are broken.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




 Project Planning \& Sprint Management
 



 ● Own end\-to\-end project plans for consulting engagements — from client onboarding and
 



 charter creation through milestone tracking to final delivery.
 



 ● Build and maintain sprint cycles (typically 2\-week cadence) with clear goals, backlogs, and
 



 acceptance criteria for each sprint.
 



 ● Run sprint planning, sprint review, and retrospective calls with Engagement Leads and relevant
 



 team leads.
 



 ● Maintain project workspaces in ClickUp (or equivalent tools) with consistent structure, fields,
 



 and governance — ensuring cross\-team visibility without redundant or conflicting data.
 



 Delivery Ownership \& Risk Management
 



 ● Track progress across all active consulting engagements and flag delays before they surface as
 



 client escalations.
 



 ● Engage with Engagement Leads to validate timeline estimates — push back when scopes are
 



 underestimated, and get commitments adjusted proactively.
 



 ● Coordinate dependencies across consulting, data engineering, and engineering/infrastructure
 



 teams to unblock execution.
 



 ● Maintain a clear view of what each client is at, what stage their delivery is in, and what the next
 



 sprint goal is at any point in time.
 



  





 Stakeholder Communication
 



 ● Serve as the central coordination point between Engagement Leads and Data Engineering pods
 



 — translate consulting asks into actionable technical tickets with proper acceptance criteria.
 



 ● Present bi\-weekly delivery status updates to internal stakeholders; communicate sprint goals
 



 and upcoming milestones clearly.
 



 ● Over time, participate in client\-facing demos and delivery reviews (bi\-weekly cadence),
 



 representing project status and next sprint goals.
 



  





 Process Governance \& Adoption
 



 ● Drive adoption of standardised project management processes across consulting pods —
 



 including ticket templates, milestone definitions, and sprint hygiene.
 



 ● Create and maintain process documentation for delivery workflows, escalation paths, and
 



 onboarding playbooks for new team members.
 



 ● Conduct onboarding sessions for new joiners covering e\-commerce domain basics, connector
 



 landscape, and cross\-team workflows.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 Must\-Have
 



 ● 3–6 years of experience in project/program management, preferably in a data, analytics, or
 



 tech services environment.
 



 ● Demonstrated ability to run Agile/Scrum workflows — sprint planning, backlog management,
 



 retrospectives — with cross\-functional teams.
 



 ● Strong coordination skills across multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders with competing
 



 priorities.
 



 ● Experience working with project management tools (ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or similar) and the
 



 discipline to enforce governance without losing team buy\-in.
 



 ● Enough domain fluency to understand what a client ask involves technically — you don't need
 



 to build dashboards, but you should understand what makes an average\-order\-value analysis
 



 more or less complex.
 



  





 Good to Have
 



 ● Familiarity with e\-commerce and retail analytics concepts — connectors (Shopify, Amazon,
 



 etc.), BI layers, data pipelines.
 



 ● Experience managing delivery in a consulting or client\-services environment where expectations
 



 are set externally.
 



 ● Comfort with client\-facing communication — status updates, demos, expectation management.
 



 ● Understanding of data engineering workflows: connectors, data modelling, QA/certification,
 



 and dashboard/presentation layers.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 ● No client commitment is broken because a timeline risk wasn't caught early enough.
 



 ● Engagement Leads spend less time chasing cross\-team dependencies and more time on delivery
 



 quality.
 



 ● Sprint velocity and milestone adherence are trackable, visible, and consistently improving.
 



 ● New hires on the consulting team understand how delivery works within the first two weeks.

description:
Join us as a Scrum Master
   

  

* We’re looking for an experienced Scrum Master to drive a culture of continuous improvement
* You’ll make sure that your team lives by the values of Scrum, empowering them to become high performing to increase the productivity, as well as frequency and quality of delivery
* Hone your project skills as you work with talented people in collaborative and innovative environment, with access to the bank's Agile community, experts and events
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 This role will see you coaching and guiding your team to perform at their highest level and at a sustainable pace. You’ll remove any impediments to progress, facilitate meetings, protect the team from outside influences or distractions and work with the product owner to make sure that the product backlog is in good shape and ready for the next sprint.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Making sure the Scrum team understands Agile practices, the Scrum framework and values, and that the team uses this framework to deliver working software to satisfy platform customers and react to their needs quickly
* Transforming the Scrum team to become self\-organising to reduce management overhead costs, using techniques such as Systems and Lean thinking
* Acting as the process owner for the team, and maintaining relationships with the project's key stakeholders
* Creating a great place to work with a culture of safety and continuous improvement, through great people leadership, coaching, engagement and development of skills


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 We're looking for someone with experience of successful Scrum adoption along with a Scrum Master certification. You'll need knowledge of modern development practices and tools, as well as a background in coaching cross\-functional teams into high performing teams.
   

  

 You’ll also need knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency, as well as experience of building a culture of transparency within feature teams by empowering individuals and inspiring a collaborative team performance.
   

  

**We'll Look To You To Have**
* Strong Agile \& Scrum expertise, with deep knowledge of the Agile methodology and principles.
* Proven Agile coaching experience, driving mindset, culture, and behavioural change across teams and departments.
* Experience leading organisational and team transformations, improving ways of working and delivery effectiveness
* Mandatory experience in Off host project delivery and end\-to\-end Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) management.
* Hands\-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Planview and ServiceNow for agile delivery, governance, and reporting.
* Good understanding of automated testing frameworks, CI/CD, and quality engineering practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with a focus on dependency, risk, and delivery management.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**AI Scrum Master:** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced AI Scrum Master with 5\-8 years of experience to drive Agile delivery for AI/ML and technology\-focused projects. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Scrum/Agile methodologies and experience working with cross\-functional technical teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 \- Lead and facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
 



  





 \- Drive Agile delivery across AI/ML, Data Science, GenAI, or technology\-driven projects.
 



  





 \- Work closely with Product Owners, Developers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and business stakeholders.
 



  





 \- Remove impediments, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure smooth sprint execution.
 



  





 \- Support backlog management, estimation, prioritization, and sprint planning.
 



  





 \- Track project progress, identify delivery risks, and communicate updates to stakeholders.
 



  





 \- Coach teams on Agile/Scrum best practices and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
 



  





 \- Facilitate collaboration between technical and business teams.
 



  





 \- Adapt Agile practices to the unique requirements of AI/ML and data\-driven projects.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 




  





 \- 5\-8 years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Project Manager, or Agile Delivery Lead.
 



  





 \- Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and project delivery.
 



  





 \- Experience working with AI/ML, GenAI, Data Science, or technology product development teams.
 



  





 \- Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills.
 



  





 \- Experience with Agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
 



  





 \- Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
 



  





 \- CSM, PSM, SAFe, or equivalent certification is an added advantage.
 



  





**Preferred Candidate Background:** 




  





 \- Candidates with experience in Big 4 consulting firms such as Deloitte, PwC, EY, or KPMG will be preferred.
 



  





 \- Candidates graduated from Tier 1 or Tier 2 colleges/institutes will be preferred.
 



  





 \- Prior experience working on AI/ML, GenAI, Data Science, or complex technology transformation projects will be highly valued.
 



  





 \- Strong exposure to working with senior stakeholders and cross\-functional technical teams is preferred.

title: Cloud Scrum Master
description:

We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. * Lead the adoption and scaling of Agile frameworks tailored for Cloud Agile projects.
* Advocate for ethical and responsible Cloud practices, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and company policies.
* Develop and track Agile metrics and KPIs to measure team performance and value delivery.


**Agile work and Collaboration**

* Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration, removing impediments and optimizing team workflows.
* Guide vendor and partner Agile implementation, ensuring alignment with Agile ways of working.
* Lead onboarding for new team members and initiatives, ensuring smooth transitions and rapid productivity.
* Support delivering training programs on Agile, JIRA, and intelligent workflows for internal teams and external partners.


**Communication and Value Articulation**
* Effectively articulate the value of Agile methodologies, fostering trust and collaboration among matrixed teams, including BI\&T, business stakeholders, and both internal and external development partners.
* Clearly communicate project status, risks, and business outcomes to the Cloud Engineering and Infrastructure team, translating complex technical concepts into accessible language for non\-technical audiences.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Gather feedback from teams and stakeholders to identify areas for process improvement.
* Drive continuous enhancement of Agile practices, leveraging industry trends and best practices.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* 7\+ years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach in technology, pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare environments.
* Proven experience delivering cloud development projects, prioritizing AWS.
* Proven track record of leading Agile teams for application development, digital, or data\-driven initiatives from planning to execution.
* Experience managing cross\-functional teams and collaborating with external vendors/partners.
* Strong project management skills sprint planning, backlog refinement, deliverable coordination.
* Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to interpret and communicate technical Cloud/AI/data concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Familiarity with compliance and governance (e.g., GxP standards, data privacy, regulatory requirements).
* Solution\-oriented troubleshooting and support with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Competence in JIRA, Confluence, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure,GCP) preferred.
