title: Lead Scrum Master
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Scrum Master with strong project management expertise to join our Product Delivery organization. In this hybrid role, you will not only champion Agile practices across multiple teams but also manage complex software projects end‑to‑end. You will partner with stakeholders at all levels to deliver industry‑leading HR solutions aligned with PrismHR’s strategic goals.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep Agile experience, strong project leadership, exceptional communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to drive clarity, manage risks, and deliver high‑quality products on time.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Agile Leadership \& Team Facilitation
   

  

* Lead all Agile ceremonies, including daily standups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Coach and guide 3\+ Agile teams to collaborate effectively and deliver value in a fast‑paced environment.
* Facilitate discussions, remove impediments, and resolve conflicts to keep teams moving forward.
* Champion Agile principles and drive a culture of continuous improvement.


**Project Management \& Delivery Execution**
* Manage multiple simultaneous software projects, ensuring clear timelines, defined milestones, and alignment with business goals.
* Maintain and continually update sprint plans, release schedules, and delivery roadmaps.
* Use project management best practices to create structured plans, track progress, and manage scope.
* Identify risks early, develop mitigation strategies, and ensure timely escalations when needed.
* Drive all phases of product development to achieve high‑quality, on‑time delivery.


**Operational Excellence \& Process Improvement**
* Capture Agile metrics and use data to assess team performance and support informed decision‑making.
* Partner with Product Delivery leadership to evaluate processes and recommend improvements.
* Promote efficiency, transparency, and predictability across teams and workflows.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 7\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master within a SaaS product development organization.

* Expertise in Agile/Scrum/Kanban/SAFe frameworks.
* Experience working with highly remote or geographically dispersed teams.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, organizational, and time‑management skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* High sense of urgency and willingness to provide follow‑up outside standard business hours when necessary.
* Scrum Master certification (CSM) or equivalent experience.
* Proven experience using Jira.
* Ability to work US time zones a must.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
Senior Scrum Master
 



 Bangalore, India
 



  





**Want to be a bswifter?** 




*At bswift we’ve been transforming benefits administration since 1996, making it simpler, smarter, and more human. Our state\-of\-the\-art, cloud\-based technology and services empower employees to understand, manage, and love their benefits. From downtown Chicago, and remotely across the country, we serve thousands of companies and millions of people nationwide, reducing administrative burdens and freeing HR teams to focus on creating thriving, people\-first workplaces.* 




*We’re looking for motivated and goal\-driven individuals who share our passion for delivering excellence and creating solutions that make a difference. The reward is a fun, flexible and creative environment with ample opportunity for professional and personal growth. If you love the bswift values of pursue excellence, embrace accountability, deliver superior service, and be a great place to work, we want to hear from you!* 




  





**Position Summary** 




 You will join the team as a Senior Scrum Master, responsible for guiding and enabling multiple Agile teams at bswift. This role is responsible for driving delivery excellence, strengthening Agile practices, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement across cross\-functional product teams — including teams that increasingly blend human engineering with AI\-assisted development.
 



 You'll work closely with engineering, product, and cross\-functional teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable enterprise software that enables seamless user experiences.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Lead and coach multiple Scrum teams for predictable, high\-quality, end\-to\-end delivery.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies and uphold Scrum principles, bswift standards, and delivery discipline.
* Collaborate with Product Owners on backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and business alignment.
* Coordinate cross\-team dependencies, risks, and release planning with transparent stakeholder communication.
* Drive continuous improvement using metrics, retrospectives, and best practices.
* Mentor team members and junior Scrum Masters, building a self\-organizing, high\-performance culture.
* Ensure quality standards, accurate Agile tracking, and delivery per definition of done.
* Ensure alignment with bswift's governance, data\-privacy, security, and compliance standards; escalate risks appropriately.
* Support PI Planning, capacity planning, governance, and process optimization.
* Prior hands\-on SDLC experience (as QA, BA, or Dev) to go beyond running ceremonies — reviewing and reinforcing definition of done, shaping scoping and acceptance criteria, strengthening dependency management, supporting UAT, and catching gaps early.
* Leverage automation and AI tools to streamline sprint reporting, dependency tracking, and retrospective insights — freeing up time for high\-value coaching.



  





**Knowledge, Education, and Experience** 




**Education \& Certifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, PMI\-ACP, or equivalent Agile certification preferred



**Experience:** 



* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams.
* Proven success leading multiple Agile teams in a complex, scaled environment.
* Strong grounding in backlog management, sprint planning, release coordination, and cross\-team delivery, including managing dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication across distributed teams.
* Experience with Agile transformation, continuous improvement, and delivery governance.
* Prior hands\-on delivery experience as QA, BA, or Developer (preferred) — bringing practical SDLC understanding and credibility with engineering teams.
* Familiarity with DevOps workflows and modern engineering practices, including teams using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar).
* Experience in enterprise SaaS, healthcare, HR tech, or benefits administration domains (preferred)



**Knowledge \& Skills:** 



* Strong knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and practical application in real\-world teams.
* Strong skills in facilitation, conflict resolution, coaching, servant leadership, and change management.
* Hands\-on expertise with Agile tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar, along with AI\-powered productivity tools for meeting summarization, reporting, and documentation.
* Understanding of product lifecycles, SDLC, project management fundamentals, and quality standards.
* Ability to interpret and use delivery metrics to guide decisions and improvements, including metrics suited to AI\-augmented teams such as flow efficiency, review throughput, and rework rate.
* Awareness of responsible\-AI principles including data privacy, security, and human\-in\-the\-loop accountability.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence across teams.



  





**Why Join bswift?** 




 At bswift, we empower our employees to make a meaningful impact, innovate, and grow. Joining our team means stepping into a collaborative and dynamic environment that values creativity, initiative, and a passion for client success. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and values each team member’s unique contributions.
 



  





**Benefits of Working at bswift:** 




**Comprehensive Health Benefits** 
 : Medical, Accidental and Term Life Insurance coverage to support your wellness and that of your family.
 



**Competitive Compensation** 
 : A compensation package that recognizes your skills, experience, and contributions, including performance\-based incentives for most roles.
 



**Hybrid work\-model:** 
 With flexible working hours
 



**Retirement Savings Plans** 
 : Options like Provident Fund and Gratuity to help you plan for a secure financial future with employer contribution
 



**Professional Development** 
 : Opportunities for career growth, including training and access to resources to support your career progression.
 



**Supportive Culture** 
 : A work environment that encourages collaboration, open communication, and creative problem\-solving, where your voice and ideas are valued.
 



**Employee Wellbeing Initiatives** 
 : Programs focused on mental health, financial planning, and wellness resources to help you thrive inside and outside of work.
 



**Make an Impact** 
 : At bswift, your work directly contributes to transforming how organizations approach benefits administration and client engagement. Join us to be part of an organization that is making a meaningful difference in the lives of our clients and their employees.

title: Agile Project Coordinator
description:
**Overview**
 Radancy is the global leader in talent acquisition software, helping employers attract and hire the right talent through AI\-powered recruiting technology, data\-driven insights, and world\-class candidate experiences. Our platform enables organizations to streamline hiring, strengthen employer branding, and drive measurable recruitment outcomes at scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Agile Project Coordinator for the Radancy UI Delivery Development and Support team based in the GDC India office, you will help keep UI delivery work clear, visible and moving. This role, partners closely with the Director of Engineering Delivery, supports an Agile\-esque Scrum\-ban process and works with developers, project managers, and QA teams to keep intake, prioritization, daily progress, blockers, and project status on track.
   

  

 We welcome applications on a rolling basis and encourage interested candidates to apply at any time. There is no fixed deadline for submissions as we continuously review applications to identify candidates whose skills and experiences align with our current and future needs. We appreciate your interest in joining our team!
   

  

**What does a great Agile Project Coordinator do?**
* Support an Agile\-esque Scrum\-ban process for the Radancy UI Delivery Development and Support team.
* Ensure the intake process is followed and that tickets are clear, complete, well formed, and ready for development.
* Facilitate ticket prioritization with project managers and other stakeholders to keep the team focused on the right work.
* Participate in standups, planning discussions, review meetings, and other delivery ceremonies to help maintain visibility and alignment.
* Elicit daily development updates, track progress against active work, and ensure status is current across team boards and reporting channels.
* Surface blockers quickly and work with developers, project managers, QA, and other partners to remove them.
* Monitor project health, help keep delivery on track, and notify leadership when timelines, scope, or dependencies create risk.
* Analyze team metrics and agile KPIs to identify risks, trends, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Provide reporting on project status, risks, blockers, mitigation strategies, and delivery trends.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree preferred, ideally in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in project coordination, delivery coordination, scrum coordination, or project management support within a software development environment.
* Working knowledge of Agile practices, including Scrum, Kanban, or Scrum\-ban; experience supporting a waterfall\-to\-agile transition is a plus.
* Scrum Master, Agile Coordinator, or similar agile delivery support experience preferred; ScrumMaster certification (CSM) is desirable.
* Experience working with distributed teams across different geographies, time zones, and cultures.
* General understanding of web development and related technologies, with the ability to follow technical discussions and help bridge communication between project managers, developers, and QA teams.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to clarify priorities, surface risks, and help teams align on next steps.
* Highly organized, dependable, and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage shifting priorities and keep work moving with limited supervision.
* Comfortable tracking delivery metrics, agile KPIs, project status, risks, blockers, and mitigation plans for leadership reporting.
* Collaborative and practical, with a willingness to help the team stay focused, coordinated, and accountable.


**Work Location**
 Hybrid Work Model: This is a hybrid position, requiring you to work in the Bengaluru office 3 times per week.
   

  

**Company Values:** 
 At Radancy, we are dedicated to the core values that guide our work and culture:
   

  

* Innovative Spirit Innovation leads the way. We have a rich history of developing and delivering what’s new and next while valuing every voice on our team. Together, we’re shaping the future and leading the industry forward.
* Rewarding Impact Work that matters. We strengthen organizations with transformative software that connects people around the world to meaningful careers. This work makes a difference in people’s lives and inspires our team to advance technology with purpose.
* Performance Driven Success drives results. We use data and insights to inform strategy and maximize performance for our customers, all backed by our global teams committed to exceeding expectations with unmatched expertise and support.
* Supportive Teams Collaboration is our backbone. We foster an environment that inspires our team members to deliver industry\-defining technology. We empower our teams to learn from each other, grow their skills and create positive change in their work and communities.


*Radancy is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We actively work to create an inclusive environment where all of our employees can thrive. If you require any accommodations during the application process, please reach out to us at recruiting@radancy.com , and we will work with you to meet your needs.*

title: TD And E-TD-Technical Scrum Master- Senior
description:

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Technology Consulting**
**Title:** 
**Specialist II, Technical Scrum Lead**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

**Client Technology (CT) \-** 
 focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
   

  

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** 
 EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
   

  

**Information Security (Info Sec) \-** 
 Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Technical Scrum Lead, Specialist is responsible for driving Agile adoption and execution within technology teams, ensuring efficient sprint execution and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This role involves facilitating Agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives, to keep teams aligned and productive.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead cross\-functional agile teams in iterative technology development, ensuring smooth collaboration and adherence to Agile/Scrum principles.
* Coach teams on best practices, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improving agile maturity.
* Work closely with product owners and stakeholders to define, prioritize and align technology\-related outcomes with business goals.
* Identify and proactively remove roadblocks that hinder project progress, ensuring teams have the necessary resources and support.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by maintaining transparency around scope, schedule and budget while effectively addressing concerns.
* Facilitate key agile ceremonies such as daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.
* Assist teams in estimating deliverables, increasing velocity and identifying opportunities for efficiency.
* Maintain product and sprint backlogs, ensuring tasks are documented, prioritized and aligned with evolving business needs.
* Apply agile methodologies to integrate changing customer inputs and business conditions into technology\-related product development.
* Serve as a mentor, thought leader and agile champion, participating in special projects to drive organizational agility.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in Agile project management, Scrum Master roles, or technical leadership in software development.
* Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in Scrum, Kanban and SAFe frameworks, with a deep understanding of Agile principles and best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps and other Agile project management tools.
* Proficiency in coding and technical concepts, including Java, Angular, Node.js, POSTMAN, CUCUMBER, AWS and SQL queries.
* Familiarity with version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, TDD/BDD and monitoring tools like Splunk and Honeycomb.
* Experience in monitoring and refining dashboards, optimizing workflows, and driving continuous process improvements in Agile environments.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner certification and Professional Scrum Master (CSM, PSM, SAFe) certification is preferred.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly experienced
 **Senior Scrum Master to act as a hands\-on agile leader, mentor, and performance coach within our Gurugram, India office.** 
 This role is a unique blend of deep team facilitation and agile community leadership. You will be embedded within some of our engineering development teams, guiding them to peak performance, while also serving as the local agile expert and mentor a Scrum Master Chapter.
 



 If you are a master of your craft, passionate about developing others, and ready to make a systemic impact on our agile culture, this is the perfect opportunity to advance your career.
 **Key Responsiblities** 



* Lead engineering teams as their dedicated Scrum Master, modelling advanced agile practices and fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.
* Empower the team to run their own team ceremonies by providing the necessary support, tools, and guidance. Acting as a supportive figure to ensure meetings become team\-led, productive, and value\-driven
* Partner with Product Owners and tech leads to champion advanced backlog management, prioritization techniques, and goal setting that maximizes business value.
* Drive a relentless focus on continuous improvement, using data and metrics to help your teams become more predictable, efficient, and self\-sufficient.
* Act as a coach and mentor to a Scrum Master Chapter, providing guidance, support, and an escalation path for complex challenges.
* Lead a local Community of Practice for Scrum Masters to foster knowledge sharing, collaborative problem\-solving, and the standardisation of best practices.
* Partner with leadership by contributing to the performance evaluation of the Scrum Masters you mentor, providing constructive feedback to help them grow.
* Lead Large\-Scale Planning: Play a key role in the planning, organization, and facilitation of large\-scale planning events (e.g., Big Room Planning), ensuring all teams are aligned and committed to a shared set of objectives.
* Take a leading role in identifying, managing, and resolving complex, cross\-team dependencies and risks that impact delivery.
* Develop and manage relationships with senior stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor on agile principles, delivery forecasting, and expectation management.



**Your Qualifications** 



* **Extensive Experience: Min 7 years of dedicated and proven experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach, with a clear track record of success in maturing teams and improving delivery outcomes.**
* **Hands\-On Practitioner: You are not a theorist. You have deep, practical, "in\-the\-trenches" experience with all facets of agile practices and are comfortable demonstrating 'how' as well as explaining 'why'.**
* Advanced Agile Knowledge: You have a deep understanding of the principles behind Scrum, Kanban, and other agile methodologies, and you know when and how to apply them to get results.
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification is desirable.
* Experience in Large\-Scale Planning: Proven experience facilitating large, multi\-team planning events (like PI Planning, Big Room Planning) and driving them to successful outcomes.
* Proven Mentorship Ability: Demonstrable experience formally or informally coaching and mentoring other Scrum Masters or agile practitioners to help them grow their skills.
* Leadership Qualities: Experience in people leadership (direct or indirect) is highly preferred, including guiding career development, and contributing to performance feedback.
* Expert\-Level Facilitator: Mastery of facilitation, conflict resolution, and communication skills, with the ability to navigate complex organisational dynamics and manage senior stakeholders effectively.



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   
 




 C
 

 andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled
 

 in accordance with
 

 our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to
 

 assist
 

 our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Lead Scrum Master (SAFe / PI Planning)
description:

 The Lead Scrum Master is a senior servant\-leader responsible for driving Agile excellence across multiple Scrum teams within the Engineering technology group. This role provides strategic coaching, delivery enablement, and cross\-team alignment while ensuring disciplined adherence to Agile frameworks and principles. The Lead Scrum Master will Mentor and coach other Scrum Masters, fostering capability growth and Agile maturity.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Agile Leadership \& Multi\-Team Enablement
   

  

* Lead multiple Agile teams, ensuring successful delivery using Scrum/SAFe frameworks.
* Coach teams in Agile values, ceremonies, practices, and continuous improvement.
* Lead and coach multiple Scrum teams on Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid agile frameworks
* Promote servant\-leadership, collaboration, empowerment, and transparency.
* Ensure effective communication flow and visibility of progress.
* Serve as Agile ambassador across the portfolio for the organization.
* Enabling formal and informal training on Scrum, SAFe, and Lean practices.
* Develop coaching plans to uplift Agile maturity across teams.


 AI‑Enabled SDLC Transformation

* AI‑assisted backlog refinement \& estimation
* Code generation, code review, and quality analysis
* Intelligent test automation and defect prediction

 Success Indicators

* Strong coaching outcomes for direct reports.
* Predictable, transparent, and efficient delivery.
* Drive measurable improvements in: Cycle time, Throughput \& velocity, Predictability, Quality \& rework reduction.

title: IT Project Manager - ERP
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Delivery Management Professional (SE6\) leads moderately complex delivery of an IT
   

  

 solution or product in ERP, proactively identifies improvements, manages diverse
   

  

 stakeholders, and contributes to strategic implementation. In this role, you will independently
   

  

 define and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, utilizing effective facilitation and
   

  

 analytical skills to drive value delivery. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments,
   

  

 you will connect team development with broader business objectives. Depending on the
   

  

 organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager,
   

  

 Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach.
   

  

 Description of the area
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Content Leadership: Independently defines, manages, and controls the scope of medium to


 large initiatives or significant workstreams with moderate complexity. Leads and facilitates
   

  

 the scope definition process, aligning with strategic objectives, stakeholder expectations, and
   

  

 team dependencies. Proactively identifies, analyzes, and mitigates scope\-related risks,
   

  

 manages scope changes, and champions the adoption of scope management best practices
   

  

 within the Chapter.
   

  

* Accountability/Problem Solving: Independently leads the analysis of moderate to complex


 delivery problems, driving root cause analysis and eliciting complex stakeholder needs.
   

  

 Accountable for comprehensive improvement plans and contributes to solution design and
   

  

 validation. Champions accountability, deals pragmatically with ambiguity, and uses effective
   

  

 facilitation techniques to guide teams while mentoring colleagues and building team spirit.
   

  

* Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of stakeholders across functional areas


 and develops comprehensive stakeholder communication plans. Effectively manages
   

  

 relationships to act as a trusted advisor, proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives, and
   

  

 navigates intricate stakeholder environments by resolving conflicts to ensure alignment.
   

  

* Impact/Strategy: Demonstrates consistent performance with an impact that typically extends


 to a specific product, initiative, or cluster. Contributes to achieving product or domain goals
   

  

 by ensuring value delivery, takes a proactive role in shaping team processes, and contributes
   

  

 to the implementation of strategic objectives for Informatics, the Chapter, and/or Domains.
   

  

* Complexity / (Product Size): Manages moderately complex initiatives or workstreams


 extending across a product or service. Manages the delivery of complex features, services,
   

  

 or projects (e.g., a service transition, a product release, or an Agile Release Train (ART)
   

  

 increment). Selects and tailors delivery methodologies while managing dependencies
   

  

 between activities.
   

  

* Business/Technical ability: Demonstrates strong business acumen by analyzing business


 needs and translating them into effective delivery strategies. Selects and adapts delivery
   

  

 methodologies to optimize results, manages complex delivery processes, and utilizes
   

  

 advanced delivery tools and techniques to address business challenges and contribute to
   

  

 planning.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Education / Experience
   

  

* Proven track record operating in a Delivery Management archetype (e.g., Project Manager,


 Scrum Master, RTE, Agile Coach) managing medium to large initiatives or significant
   

  

 workstreams.
   

  

* Experience managing the delivery of complex features or projects (such as service


 transitions or ART increments) across functional areas.
   

  

* Demonstrated experience translating requirements into strategic implementation plans and


 contributing to business planning and forecasting.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

* Must have experience with ERP in delivering similar sized projects
* Experience in one or more functional domains such as Manufacturing, Supply Chain,


 Finance, Procurement and commercial.
   

  

* Project Management skills training such as PMP, SAFe certification
* Strong ability to select, adapt, and apply appropriate delivery methodologies to optimize


 results.
   

  

* Proficiency in utilizing advanced delivery tools and techniques to manage complex


 processes and dependencies.
   

  

* Strong analytical skills to drive root cause analysis and propose comprehensive


 improvement plans.
   

  

**Additional Qualifications**
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to facilitate


 workshops, resolve conflicts, and act as a trusted advisor to diverse stakeholders.
   

  

* Strong coaching and mentoring mindset, capable of championing accountability, connecting


 team development with business objectives, and building chapter team spirit
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
